Dedication 獻詞

To those who believe that mathematics is not merely a collection of formulas,
but a language through which the hidden structures of reality may gradually be revealed.

獻給那些相信數學不只是公式的集合，
而是得以逐漸揭示實在隱秘結構之語言的人。

To every mathematician who has sought unity beneath diversity, to every physicist who has transformed geometry into dynamics, to every computer scientist who has discovered structure within information, to every philosopher who has pursued clarity through logic, and to every student who has dared to ask why seemingly unrelated phenomena often obey remarkably similar mathematical principles—this work is respectfully dedicated.

獻給每一位在差異之下尋求統一的數學家、將幾何轉化為動力學的物理學家、在資訊中發現結構的計算機科學家、以邏輯追求清晰的哲學家，以及每一位敢於追問「看似無關的現象何以常服從極為相似的數學原理」的學生——本書謹此獻給你們。

Social Quantum Field Theory is offered not as the final answer, but as one possible step toward a broader mathematical synthesis. If future generations discover that many of its ideas are incomplete, they should improve them. If some ideas are incorrect, they should replace them. If entirely better formulations emerge, they should be embraced without hesitation. Such is the natural evolution of mathematics.

社會量子場論並非作為最終答案提出，而是邁向更廣闊數學綜合的可能一步。若後世發現其中許多想法並不完整，應當改進之；若有錯誤，應當取代之；若出現更優的表述，應當毫不猶豫地接納。此乃數學的自然演化。

“The pursuit of structure is the pursuit of understanding.”

「追求結構，即是追求理解。」

Acknowledgements 致謝

The development of a mathematical framework is rarely the work of a single individual. Every new idea stands upon foundations established by countless generations of scholars. Although the formulation presented in this monograph is original in its organization and synthesis, its mathematical language owes an intellectual debt to many branches of modern mathematics and theoretical science.

數學框架的發展鮮少是單一個體的工作。每一新想法皆立基於無數世代學者所奠定的基礎。儘管本專著的組織與綜合為原創，其數學語言仍受惠於現代數學與理論科學的諸多分支。

To the Mathematical Sciences: calculus, linear algebra, differential equations, functional analysis, differential geometry, topology, algebraic topology, Lie theory, operator algebras, probability, information theory, optimization, numerical analysis, category theory, homological algebra, derived geometry, and higher category theory—whose cumulative development made this formulation possible.

致數學科學：微積分、線性代數、微分方程、泛函分析、微分幾何、拓撲、代數拓撲、Lie 理論、算子代數、機率、資訊理論、優化、數值分析、範疇論、同調代數、導出幾何與高階範疇論——其累積發展使本表述成為可能。

To Theoretical Physics: classical and quantum field theory, gauge theory, statistical mechanics, renormalization, and quantum information theory demonstrated the power of mathematical abstraction for systems with many interacting degrees of freedom. This work adapts only the mathematical structures and makes no claim that their physical interpretations extend directly to social systems.

致理論物理：經典與量子場論、規範理論、統計力學、重整化與量子資訊理論，展示了數學抽象對多自由度互動系統的力量。本書僅採納其數學結構，並不主張其物理詮釋直接延伸至社會系統。

To Future Readers: A mathematical framework becomes meaningful only when others examine its assumptions, verify its proofs, identify its limitations, and improve or replace its arguments. Constructive criticism is welcomed as an essential part of the scientific process.

致未來讀者：唯有當他人檢視其假設、驗證其證明、指出其限制並改進或取代其論證時，數學框架才具意義。建設性批評作為科學過程的必要部分，謹此歡迎。

“Mathematics is a conversation across generations.”

「數學是跨越世代的對話。」

Reader’s Guide 閱讀指南

This monograph spans variational calculus, differential geometry, topology, information theory, tensor networks, operator methods, and higher category theory. Different readers may therefore follow different pathways.

本專著涵蓋變分法、微分幾何、拓撲、資訊理論、張量網絡、算子方法與高階範疇論。不同背景的讀者可選擇不同閱讀路徑。

Path A — For Mathematicians 路徑 A — 數學工作者

Foundations → Variational Principles → Relational Field Equations → Symmetry & Conservation → Differential Geometry → Gauge Theory → Topology → Information Geometry → Category Theory → Higher Structures → Mathematical Axioms → Appendices.

基礎 → 變分原理 → 關係場方程 → 對稱與守恆 → 微分幾何 → 規範理論 → 拓撲 → 資訊幾何 → 範疇論 → 高階結構 → 數學公理 → 附錄。

Path B — For Physicists 路徑 B — 物理工作者

Lagrangian / Hamiltonian formalism, gauge symmetry, renormalization, path integrals, effective field theory, tensor networks. Throughout, these concepts are employed as mathematical analogies, not literal physical descriptions of social systems.

拉格朗日／哈密頓形式、規範對稱、重整化、路徑積分、有效場論、張量網絡。全文中這些概念皆作為數學類比使用，而非社會系統的字面物理描述。

Path C — For Computer Scientists 路徑 C — 計算機科學

Tensor representations, optimization, information theory, graph methods, machine learning interfaces, computational complexity, numerical simulation.

張量表示、優化、資訊理論、圖方法、機器學習介面、計算複雜度、數值模擬。

Path D — For Complex-Systems Researchers 路徑 D — 複雜系統研究者

Introduction → Relational Fields → Dynamical Systems → Information Geometry → Effective Theories → Tensor Networks → Applications.

導論 → 關係場 → 動力系統 → 資訊幾何 → 有效理論 → 張量網絡 → 應用。

Path E — For Philosophers of Science 路徑 E — 科學哲學

Axiomatization, structural realism, mathematical modeling, scientific explanation, category theory, philosophy of mathematics. The Afterword and Historical Note provide natural entry points.

公理化、結構實在論、數學建模、科學說明、範疇論、數學哲學。後記與歷史說明可作為入口。

Reading Strategy 閱讀策略

The work is organized as a layered mathematical framework rather than a strictly sequential textbook: Foundations → Dynamics → Geometry → Information → Higher Mathematics → Applications. Readers may enter at different points according to interest. Verify proofs independently; distinguish established results from conjectures; compare with existing literature.

本書以層次化數學框架組織，而非嚴格線性教科書：基礎 → 動力學 → 幾何 → 資訊 → 高階數學 → 應用。可依興趣從不同節點進入。請獨立驗證證明、區分已確立結果與猜想、並與既有文獻比較。

Historical Note for Future Editions 未來版本的歷史說明

The first edition represents the initial formal presentation of a research program whose long-term direction is intentionally evolutionary. Definitions may be refined, notation simplified, theorems strengthened, and early conjectures modified or replaced in light of new mathematical insights.

第一版是一項長期方向刻意採演化進路的研究計畫之首次正式表述。定義可精煉、符號可簡化、定理可強化，早期猜想亦可在新的數學洞見下修正或取代。

Phases of Development 發展階段

Phase I (First Edition): Foundational construction — architectural coherence over exhaustive formal completeness.
Phase II: Mathematical consolidation — axiomatic independence, existence/uniqueness, regularity, stability, convergence proofs.
Phase III: Computational maturity — reference implementations, verified algorithms, automated verification.
Phase IV: Comparative mathematical analysis with graph theory, dynamical systems, information geometry, category theory, topology.
Phase V: Community development — alternative formulations, counterexamples, educational materials.

第一階段（第一版）：基礎建構——建築連貫性優先於窮盡形式完備。
第二階段：數學鞏固——公理獨立性、存在／唯一性、正則性、穩定性、收斂證明。
第三階段：計算成熟——參考實作、驗證算法、自動化驗證。
第四階段：與圖論、動力系統、資訊幾何、範疇論、拓撲的比較分析。
第五階段：社群發展——替代表述、反例、教材。

A first edition begins a conversation.
A mature mathematical theory is written by the generations that continue it.

第一版開啟對話。

Editorial Retrospective 編輯回顧

From Manuscript to Research Program從手稿到研究計畫

The earliest conception of Social Quantum Field Theory (SQFT) was not intended to establish a finished theory. Rather, it began with a modest mathematical question: Can the language of fields, symmetries, geometry, and variational principles be generalized to describe abstract relational systems beyond their traditional physical domains?

社會量子場論（SQFT）的最初構想，並非旨在建立一套完成的理論。相反，它始於一個謙遜的數學問題：場、對稱、幾何與變分原理的語言，能否被推廣以描述超越其傳統物理領域的抽象關係系統？

As the project evolved, it became apparent that answering this question required more than introducing new notation. It demanded a coherent mathematical architecture capable of integrating concepts from multiple disciplines while preserving internal consistency and maintaining clear distinctions between formal mathematics and empirical interpretation. This realization transformed the project from a single manuscript into a broader research program.

隨著計畫演進，顯然回答這個問題需要的不只是引入新符號。它要求一套連貫的數學架構，能夠整合多學科概念，同時保持內部一致性，並清楚區分形式數學與經驗詮釋。此一體認使計畫從單一手稿轉變為更廣泛的研究計畫。

Evolution of the Series系列的演進

Volume I established the foundational concepts: relational fields, action principles, symmetry, topology, information geometry, higher categorical perspectives.

第一卷建立基礎概念：關係場、作用原理、對稱、拓撲、資訊幾何、高階範疇觀點。

Companion Volume II strengthened the analytical foundations through rigorous proofs, functional analysis, operator theory, nonlinear analysis, geometric methods.

配套第二卷透過嚴格證明、泛函分析、算子理論、非線性分析、幾何方法，強化分析基礎。

Companion Volume III focused on computational realization: numerical algorithms, tensor methods, graph computation, artificial intelligence, reproducible software.

配套第三卷聚焦計算實現：數值演算法、張量方法、圖計算、人工智慧、可重現軟體。

Companion Volumes IV–VI explored interdisciplinary applications, empirical validation methodology, and future mathematical directions.

配套第四至六卷探索跨學科應用、經驗驗證方法論，以及未來數學方向。

Lessons Learned所學課題

1. Mathematical Generality Requires Precision. Broad conceptual ideas are valuable only when accompanied by precise definitions and explicit assumptions.

1. 數學普遍性需要精確性。 寬泛的概念想法只有在伴隨精確定義與明確假設時才有價值。

2. Analogy Has Limits. Mathematical analogy should never be confused with physical identity. Maintaining this distinction is essential to avoid category errors.

2. 類比有其限度。 數學類比絕不應與物理同一性混淆。維持此一區分對於避免範疇錯誤至關重要。

3. Interdisciplinary Work Demands Humility. No single mathematical framework should be expected to supersede existing theories across diverse fields.

3. 跨學科工作需要謙遜。 不應期待單一數學框架能在多元領域中取代既有理論。

4. Computation Is Part of Modern Mathematics. The integration of computational methods is an essential extension of mathematical practice.

4. 計算是現代數學的一部分。 計算方法的整合是數學實踐的本質延伸。

5. Scientific Progress Is Collective. The long-term value of SQFT depends upon independent verification, constructive criticism, and continual refinement by the broader community.

5. 科學進步是集體的。 SQFT 的長期價值依賴獨立驗證、建設性批評，以及更廣泛社群的持續精煉。

1.1 The Research Problem 1.1 研究問題

Social action occurs within relational settings: positions, resources, institutions, and shared expectations shape the possibilities available to participants. This monograph investigates how such settings may be represented by explicit mathematical models. Its central problem is to connect a representation of relational organization to observable data, a specified evolution rule, and propositions whose assumptions and conclusions can be checked independently.

社會行動發生於關係情境之中：位置、資源、制度與共同預期形塑參與者可採取的行動可能性。本專著探討如何以明確的數學模型表示這些情境。其核心問題是將關係組織的表示，連結至可觀測資料、指定的演化規則，以及假設與結論均可獨立檢查的命題。

Social Quantum Field Theory (SQFT) is developed here as a research programme for constructing and comparing relational models. The name identifies the programme's mathematical inspiration; it does not establish that social systems obey microscopic quantum mechanics. The usefulness of any particular model must be assessed through its mathematical consistency, interpretability, and performance on a stated empirical task.

本書將社會量子場論（SQFT）發展為建構與比較關係模型的研究計畫。此名稱標示本計畫的數學靈感，並不確立社會系統服從微觀量子力學。任何具體模型的實用性，都必須依其數學一致性、可詮釋性，以及在明定經驗任務上的表現加以評估。

1.2 Relational Representation and Existing Approaches 1.2 關係表示與既有進路

Relational representation does not require a choice between isolated individuals and a single all-encompassing field. Network models, dynamical systems, latent-variable models, and higher-order interaction models provide different ways to express interdependence. In particular, higher-order network methods already address interactions involving groups of participants [1]. SQFT must therefore be compared with concrete alternatives rather than justified by a presumed inability of existing mathematics to describe collective organization.

關係表示不要求在孤立個體與單一包羅萬象的場之間二擇一。網路模型、動力系統、潛在變數模型與高階交互作用模型，提供表達相互依賴的不同方式。尤其，高階網路方法已處理涉及多位參與者的群體交互作用 [1]。因此，SQFT 應與具體替代模型比較，而不應以既有數學無法描述集體組織的預設作為其正當性基礎。

Bourdieu's field-based sociology provides an intellectual motivation for investigating positions and relations [2]. A mathematical reconstruction, however, introduces choices that sociological concepts alone do not determine: the state space, the measurable variables, the observation map, and the evolution law. These choices require explicit justification. The formalism proposed below is consequently a modelling proposal, not a deductive translation of Bourdieu's theory.

布迪厄以場為基礎的社會學，為研究位置與關係提供思想動機 [2]。然而，數學重構會引入社會學概念本身無法決定的選擇，包括狀態空間、可測量變數、觀測映射與演化律。這些選擇需要明確的理由。因此，下文提出的形式系統是一項建模方案，而不是從布迪厄理論演繹而得的翻譯。

1.3 A Minimal Mathematical Starting Point 1.3 最小數學起點

The initial model class is finite-dimensional. Let H=Cd, where 1≤d<∞. A model state is a density matrix in the set

初始模型類採用有限維設定。令 H=Cd，其中 1≤d<∞。模型狀態為下列集合中的密度矩陣：

D(H)={ρ∈Cd×d:ρ=ρ†, ρ⪰0, Trρ=1}.(1.1)

Here ρ† denotes the conjugate transpose, and ρ⪰0 denotes positive semidefiniteness. This representation follows standard operator-based probability [3]. Its selection is a model assumption. It neither establishes an ontology of society nor guarantees that an arbitrary empirical dataset determines a unique matrix.

此處 ρ† 表示共軛轉置，ρ⪰0 表示正半定。此表示採用標準的算子機率框架 [3]。選擇這種表示是模型假設；它既不確立社會的本體論，也不保證任意經驗資料集都能決定唯一矩陣。

For a finite observation set Y, choose operators Ey​⪰0 satisfying ∑y∈Y​Ey​=Id​. The observation rule is

對有限觀測集合 Y，選取滿足 ∑y∈Y​Ey​=Id​ 的算子 Ey​⪰0。觀測規則定為：

p(y∣ρ)=Tr(ρEy​).(1.2)

Proposition 1.1 (Validity of the observation probabilities; standard result). Under the assumptions above, Equation (1.2) defines a probability distribution on Y.

命題 1.1（觀測機率的合法性；標準結果）。在上述假設下，式 (1.2) 定義了 Y 上的機率分布。

Proof. Cyclicity of the trace gives Tr(ρEy​)=Tr(ρ1/2Ey​ρ1/2)≥0, since the matrix inside the latter trace is positive semidefinite. Moreover, ∑y​Tr(ρEy​)=Tr(ρId​)=1. Thus every probability lies in [0,1] and the probabilities sum to one. □

證明。由跡的循環性，Tr(ρEy​)=Tr(ρ1/2Ey​ρ1/2)≥0，因為後一跡中的矩陣為正半定。此外，∑y​Tr(ρEy​)=Tr(ρId​)=1。因此，各機率皆位於 [0,1]，且總和為一。□

An empirical application must state what each outcome means and how its frequency is recorded. If parameters θ determine ρθ​ and the observation operators, their identifiability must be examined through the resulting observation distributions. The preceding proposition guarantees mathematical validity of the probabilities, not adequacy of their interpretation or uniqueness of their estimation.

經驗應用必須說明每一結果的意義及其頻率如何記錄。若參數 θ 決定 ρθ​ 與觀測算子，就必須透過所得觀測分布檢查參數的可識別性。前述命題保證機率在數學上的合法性，並不保證其詮釋適切或估計唯一。

1.4 The Classical Baseline 1.4 經典基線

A density-matrix representation need not introduce nonclassical effects. Suppose the state and all observation operators are diagonal in a common orthonormal basis:

密度矩陣表示未必引入非經典效應。假設狀態與全部觀測算子在共同的正交歸一基底中皆為對角形式：

ρ=i=1∑d​qi​∣i⟩⟨i∣,Ey​=i=1∑d​eyi​∣i⟩⟨i∣.(1.3)

The density-matrix and observation assumptions imply qi​≥0, ∑i​qi​=1, eyi​≥0, and ∑y​eyi​=1. Substituting (1.3) into (1.2) yields

密度矩陣與觀測假設給出 qi​≥0、∑i​qi​=1、eyi​≥0 與 ∑y​eyi​=1。將式 (1.3) 代入式 (1.2)，得到：

p(y∣ρ)=i=1∑d​qi​eyi​.(1.4)

Equation (1.4) is the classical law of total probability, with qi​ as latent-state probabilities and eyi​ as conditional observation probabilities. Accordingly, collective dependence or coordinated behaviour alone does not demonstrate the need for noncommuting operators. Any proposed advantage of a noncommutative extension must be evaluated against an explicit classical baseline.

式 (1.4) 即經典全機率公式，其中 qi​ 為潛在狀態機率，eyi​ 為條件觀測機率。因此，集體依賴或協同行為本身，並不能證明非交換算子的必要性。任何非交換擴充所主張的優勢，都必須與明確的經典基線比較。

1.5 Dynamics and the Meaning of a Field 1.5 動力學與場的意義

A dynamical model also requires an evolution rule. In the finite-dimensional core, one may specify completely positive, trace-preserving maps Et,s​ and write ρt​=Et,s​(ρs​) for t≥s. A time-homogeneous Markov semigroup is a further restriction, not a consequence of a system being open. Its generator and assumptions must be stated explicitly; the standard bounded-generator theory provides a reference point [4].

動態模型還需要演化規則。在有限維核心中，可指定完全正且保跡的映射 Et,s​，並對 t≥s 寫成 ρt​=Et,s​(ρs​)。時間齊次的 Markov 半群是進一步的限制，而不是系統開放便可推出的結果。其生成元與假設必須明確陳述；標準的有界生成元理論提供一個參照起點 [4]。

The term relational field will be used only with a stated mathematical meaning. A spatially indexed extension may involve a map Φ:M→V or a section of a specified bundle. Such an extension requires additional choices of domain, regularity, geometry, and observables. It is not supplied automatically by the density matrix in (1.1), and it must not be conflated with an operator-valued quantum field.

「關係場」一詞僅在明定其數學意義時使用。具有空間索引的擴充，可涉及映射 Φ:M→V 或指定纖維叢的截面。這類擴充需要另外選定定義域、正則性、幾何與可觀測量。式 (1.1) 的密度矩陣並不自動提供這些結構，也不應與算子值量子場混為一談。

1.6 Standards of Argument 1.6 論證標準

The revised text distinguishes definitions, modelling assumptions, established mathematical results, conjectures, and empirical hypotheses. A theorem must identify its domain and hypotheses and provide a proof or a precise reference. A definition fixes terminology; it does not establish an empirical regularity. An interpretation assigns meaning to formal objects and remains open to revision when confronted with data.

修訂文本區分定義、模型假設、已確立的數學結果、猜想與經驗假說。定理必須交代其定義域與假設，並提供證明或精確來源。定義確立術語，並不確立經驗規律。詮釋賦予形式物件意義，並在面對資料時保持可修訂性。

Mathematical consistency and empirical adequacy are separate requirements. A model can be internally coherent yet predict poorly; conversely, a fitted equation can describe observations without supporting the proposed interpretation. Empirical comparisons should specify the observation process, uncertainty, baseline models, and evaluation criteria. Predictive success alone does not identify a causal mechanism or justify an intervention.

數學一致性與經驗適切性是不同要求。模型可能內部連貫卻預測不佳；反之，擬合方程也可能描述觀測，卻不足以支持所提詮釋。經驗比較應指定觀測過程、不確定性、基線模型與評估準則。預測成功本身不會識別因果機制，也不足以正當化干預。

1.7 Scope and Contributions 1.7 範圍與貢獻

The intended contribution is a disciplined organization of relational modelling choices and their connections. Standard results about matrices, channels, geometry, or topology retain their established attribution. Any new claim specific to SQFT must be distinguished from those results and supported separately. This chapter establishes a valid observation rule and its classical special case; it does not prove a universal representation theorem for social systems.

本書預期的貢獻，是有條理地組織關係建模的選擇及其連結。關於矩陣、通道、幾何或拓撲的標準結果，保留其既有歸屬。任何屬於 SQFT 的新主張，都必須與這些結果區別，並另行支持。本章建立合法的觀測規則及其經典特例，並未證明社會系統的普遍表示定理。

1.8 Reading Guide for the Revision 1.8 修訂版閱讀指南

Chapter 2 examines the conceptual relation to field-based sociology. The foundational chapters then specify states, observations, composition, and dynamics before returning to a worked coordination model. Later chapters address estimation, computation, geometry, and possible extensions. During the chapter-by-chapter revision, the original numbering is retained for traceability. A chapter marked as inherited remains first-edition material awaiting review; it should not be read as having already met the standards stated here.

第 2 章檢視與場取向社會學的概念關係。基礎章節接著明定狀態、觀測、複合與動力學，再回到完整的協調模型。後續章節處理估計、計算、幾何與可能的擴充。逐章修訂期間保留原章號，以維持可追溯性。標為沿用的章節仍是待審查的第一版內容，不應視為已符合本章所述標準。

Chapter 2 · From Bourdieu’s Field Theory to Social Quantum Field Theory第 2 章 · 從布迪厄場論到社會量子場論

Revised draft · 已修訂草稿

2.1 Purpose and Scope2.1 目的與範圍

This chapter develops the conceptual motivation for SQFT and specifies the limits of that motivation. Relational sociology directs attention to positions, resources and histories. It does not by itself select a unique mathematical representation. The task is to construct a model whose variables, assumptions and observable consequences can be assessed.

本章闡述 SQFT 的概念動機，並界定此動機的推論範圍。關係社會學引導研究者關注位置、資源與歷史，但本身並不指定唯一的數學表示。研究任務是建構其變數、假設與可觀測後果皆可供評估的模型。

2.2 Field as a Sociological Concept2.2 作為社會學概念的場域

In Bourdieu’s account, a field concerns objective relations among positions, the distribution of relevant capital, and struggles over the stakes of participation [1, pp. 39–40]. In this chapter, “field” in that sociological sense is translated as 場域. The mathematical term “field” is translated as 場 when it denotes a function defined over a specified domain. The shared English word does not establish a mathematical equivalence.

在布迪厄的論述中，場域涉及位置間的客觀關係、相關資本的分配，以及圍繞參與利害的鬥爭［1，第 39–40 頁］。本章將此社會學意義的 field 譯作「場域」；當數學上的 field 指定義在某個明確定義域上的函數時，則譯作「場」。英文用詞相同，並不構成數學上的等價關係。

2.3 Capital: Holdings and Contextual Efficacy2.3 資本：持有量與情境效力

The efficacy of capital is field-dependent in Bourdieu’s discussion [1, pp. 39–40]. This does not imply that every participant in a field holds the same resources. A proposed operationalization should therefore distinguish actor-specific holdings from their contextual valuation. For example, let i index actors, t observation times, and k a chosen resource category. Let rik​(t)≥0 denote a measured holding and let Ft​ denote a coded field context. One possible model is

在布迪厄的討論中，資本的效力依賴場域［1，第 39–40 頁］。這不表示同一場域的所有參與者持有相同資源。因此，操作化方案應區分行動者的資源持有量及其情境評價。例如，以 i 表示行動者、t 表示觀測時間、k 表示選定的資源類別。令 rik​(t)≥0 為測得的持有量，Ft​ 為編碼後的場域情境。一種可能模型為

Cik​(t)=vk​(rik​(t),Ft​),vk​:R≥0​×F→R.(2.1)

Here F is the declared set of coded contexts and Cik​(t) is an operational score. Its scale and the function vk​ require specification and validation; scores for different categories need not be commensurable. Equation (2.1) is a proposed measurement construction, not a formula attributed to Bourdieu. The first-edition expression C=C(F) suppressed the actor and resource distinctions.

此處 F 是明定的編碼情境集合，Cik​(t) 是操作性評分。其尺度與函數 vk​ 必須另行指定及驗證；不同資源類別的分數未必可直接比較。式（2.1）是建議的測量建構，並非歸於布迪厄的公式。第一版的 C=C(F) 省略了行動者與資源類別之間的區別。

Illustrative case. The longer first-edition volume uses a university degree to illustrate contextual valuation. Holding a coded qualification fixed, its operational score may differ between two coded contexts if the chosen valuation function assigns different values. Context change alone does not guarantee a nonzero difference. This conditional illustration requires empirical support before it can describe actual academic, financial or political settings.

示意案例。第一版分卷長版以大學學位說明情境評價。固定編碼後的資格，若選定的評價函數在兩種編碼情境下給予不同數值，其操作性評分便可能不同。情境改變本身並不保證差值非零。此條件式例子必須獲得經驗支持，才能用來描述實際的學術、金融或政治情境。

2.4 Habitus and Historical Dependence2.4 慣習與歷史依賴

Habitus refers to historically formed dispositions associated with practice [1]. A model may represent some aspects through variables summarizing learning or trajectories, but such variables are selective proxies. Similar histories do not entail identical dispositions, and similar dispositions do not imply exact synchronization. Any synchronization claim requires a stated dynamic law, a definition of synchronization and evidence appropriate to that definition.

慣習指與實踐相關、由歷史形成的傾向［1］。模型可以用概括學習或生命軌跡的變數表示其中某些面向，但這些變數只是選擇性的代理指標。相似歷史不蘊含相同傾向，相似傾向也不蘊含精確同步。任何同步主張都需要明定動力學規則、同步的定義，以及符合該定義的證據。

2.5 From Concepts to a Specified Model2.5 從概念到明確模型

A formal translation must identify the population, observational units, time scale, state variables and observation procedure. For a weighted graph representation, G=(V,E,w), V is a specified set of nodes, E⊆V×V a declared set of directed relations, and w:E→R a weight function with a stated interpretation. Choosing positions rather than persons as nodes changes the empirical meaning. Such a graph represents selected relations within a field; it is not a complete mathematical definition of Bourdieu’s concept.

形式轉譯必須交代研究母體、觀測單位、時間尺度、狀態變數與觀測程序。對加權圖表示 G=(V,E,w)，V 是指定的節點集合，E⊆V×V 是明定的有向關係集合，w:E→R 是具有指定詮釋的權重函數。以位置而非個人作為節點，會改變模型的經驗意義。此圖表示場域中選定的關係，並非對布迪厄概念的完整數學定義。

2.6 Coordination and Shared Context: A Classical Example2.6 協調與共同情境：經典例子

Coordinated football passes motivate a question about shared training, cues and expectations. The absence of speech alone does not identify the mechanism. The following elementary result demonstrates why observed coordination cannot, by itself, establish the necessity of a quantum model. It is an illustrative probability model, not a fitted account of football.

協調傳球引出關於共同訓練、線索與預期的問題。僅憑沒有言語交流，無法辨識其機制。以下初等結果說明，單憑觀測到的協調，不能確立量子模型的必要性。這是示意性的機率模型，並非依足球資料擬合的解釋。

Proposition 2.1 (Shared context can generate marginal dependence). There exist finite classical random variables A,B,Z such that A and B are conditionally independent given Z, but are not marginally independent.

命題 2.1（共同情境可產生邊際相依）。存在有限值的經典隨機變數 A,B,Z，使 A 與 B 在給定 Z 下條件獨立，但兩者並非邊際獨立。

Proof. Let Z take values 0 and 1 with probability 1/2 each, and define A=Z and B=Z. For all a,b,z∈{0,1}, let 1a=z​ denote the indicator of equality. Then

證明。令 Z 分別以 1/2 的機率取值 0 與 1，並定義 A=Z、B=Z。對所有 a,b,z∈{0,1}，以 1a=z​ 表示相等事件的指示函數。於是

P(A=a,B=b∣Z=z)​=1a=z​1b=z​=P(A=a∣Z=z)P(B=b∣Z=z).​(2.2)

Thus conditional independence holds. Marginalization over Z gives

因此條件獨立成立。對 Z 邊際化可得

P(A=a,B=b)=z=0∑1​21​1a=z​1b=z​.(2.3)
P(A=0,B=0)=21​=41​=P(A=0)P(B=0).(2.4)

Consequently, marginal independence fails, proving the existence claim. The entire distribution is nonnegative and normalized: only (A,B)=(0,0) and (1,1) have positive mass, each 1/2. This is a standard consequence of classical probability, not a new physical principle.

因此邊際獨立不成立，存在性主張得證。整個分配非負且已正規化：只有 (A,B)=(0,0) 與 (1,1) 的機率質量為正，且各為 1/2。這是經典機率的標準結果，並非新的物理原理。

2.7 Graphs, Higher-Order Relations and Fields2.7 圖、高階關係與場

A graph and a field can coexist in one model. For example, a time-dependent vector-valued field on a finite node set may be defined as

圖與場可以並存於同一模型。例如，可在有限節點集合上定義隨時間變化的向量值場：

Φ:V×T→Rm,T⊆R,m∈N>0​.(2.5)

The graph specifies selected relations; Φ assigns values to nodes and times. Equation (2.5) alone imposes neither continuity nor a dynamic law. Multi-actor interactions can also be represented using hypergraphs or other higher-order structures [2]. These options defeat a general inference from the limits of pairwise descriptions to the necessity of quantum formalism. They do not establish that any one representation is adequate for a particular dataset.

圖指定選定的關係；Φ 將數值指派給節點與時間。單憑式（2.5），既不要求連續性，也不指定動力學規則。多行動者相互作用也可使用超圖或其他高階結構表示［2］。這些選項使「成對描述有局限，因此必須採量子形式」的普遍推論無法成立，但也不代表其中任何一種表示已足以解釋特定資料集。

2.8 The Additional Commitments of SQFT2.8 SQFT 的額外承諾

The finite-dimensional framework in Chapter 1 specifies density operators and observation effects. Adopting it requires an explicit relation between social records and mathematical states or measurements. Noncommuting operators are an additional modelling choice; sociological relationality does not prove their necessity. Claims about entanglement additionally require a declared tensor-product decomposition and a justified relation between its factors and the proposed subsystems.

第 1 章的有限維框架指定了密度算子與觀測效應算子。採用此框架，必須明確連結社會紀錄與數學上的狀態或測量。非對易算子是額外的模型選擇；社會學的關係性並不證明其必要性。糾纏主張還需要明定張量積分解，並論證各因子與所提出子系統之間的對應。

2.9 Observation, Mechanism and Model Comparison2.9 觀測、機制與模型比較

A joint distribution describes observational dependence. Reading it as a causal mechanism requires further assumptions about temporal order, interventions and omitted variables. In Proposition 2.1, the common-context construction supplies one possible generative account, not an identification theorem. An empirical SQFT study should state the target outcomes and compare its predictions with relevant classical alternatives using a declared evaluation procedure, including performance on held-out observations when available.

聯合分配描述觀測上的相依性。若要將其解讀為因果機制，還需要關於時間順序、介入與遺漏變數的額外假設。在命題 2.1 中，共同情境的建構提供了一種可能的生成解釋，並非識別定理。SQFT 的實證研究應明定目標結果，採用事先說明的評估程序，將其預測與相關經典替代模型比較；若資料允許，也應包含保留觀測資料上的表現。

2.10 Methodological Principle: Relational Specification2.10 方法論原則：明定關係結構

Modelling principle 2.A. When relations and shared contexts are substantively relevant, represent them explicitly and assess what they contribute to explanation or prediction. This is a research commitment, not a theorem asserting that field models always outperform actor-based models. The first edition’s “Field Primacy” proposition is therefore retained as a qualified methodological motivation rather than a proven ranking of model classes. Proposition 2.1 above has a different, explicitly delimited mathematical content.

建模原則 2.A。當關係與共同情境在實質上具有重要性時，應將其明確表示，並評估其對解釋或預測的貢獻。這是研究承諾，而非宣稱場模型總是優於行動者模型的定理。因此，第一版的「場優先」命題在此保留為附帶限定的方法論動機，而非模型類別優劣排序的證明。上文的命題 2.1 則具有不同且明確限定的數學內容。

2.11 Transition2.11 過渡

The bridge from Bourdieu to SQFT is a programme of operationalization and comparison. Chapter 3 discusses the philosophical status of the proposed framework; Chapter 4 presents its axiomatic formulation. Those later chapters remain pending review in this working edition. Their stronger claims must be checked against the distinctions established here.

從布迪厄通往 SQFT 的橋梁，是操作化與比較的研究計畫。第 3 章討論所提框架的哲學地位；第 4 章提出其公理表述。在本工作版本中，這些後續章節仍待審訂；其中較強的主張必須依本章建立的區分重新檢查。

References for Chapter 2第 2 章參考文獻

[1] Wacquant, L. J. D. (1989). Towards a Reflexive Sociology: A Workshop with Pierre Bourdieu. Sociological Theory, 7(1), 26–63. Includes an interview with Bourdieu; field and capital discussion, pp. 39–40.

［1］Wacquant（1989），〈邁向反思社會學：與皮耶・布迪厄的工作坊〉，Sociological Theory，7(1)，26–63。含布迪厄訪談；場域與資本的討論見第 39–40 頁。

[2] Battiston, F., et al. (2020). Networks beyond pairwise interactions: Structure and dynamics. Physics Reports, 874, 1–92. doi:10.1016/j.physrep.2020.05.004.

［2］Battiston 等（2020），〈超越成對相互作用的網路：結構與動力學〉，Physics Reports，874，1–92。

Chapter 3 · The Mathematical Philosophy of Social Quantum Field Theory第 3 章 · 社會量子場論的數學哲學

Revised draft · 已修訂草稿

3.1 Purpose of a Mathematical Language3.1 數學語言的目的

SQFT is developed here as a programme for constructing and comparing relational models. Mathematical notation is useful when it clarifies a domain, a rule of inference or an observable prediction. A new vocabulary does not itself establish explanatory progress. The relevant question is what a specified construction permits us to calculate, distinguish or test beyond an appropriate baseline.

本書將 SQFT 發展為建構及比較關係模型的研究計畫。當數學記號能釐清定義域、推論規則或可觀測預測時，它才具有用途。新的詞彙本身不確立解釋上的進展；相關問題是：明定的建構，相較於適當基準，讓我們多計算、區分或檢驗了什麼？

The relational motivation of Chapters 1–2 is retained. However, no general inadequacy of existing social-scientific methods, and no necessity of a quantum formalism, is assumed. The finite-dimensional state and measurement framework used below follows the conventions introduced in Chapter 1; the underlying mathematical tools are standard [1].

本章保留第 1–2 章的關係取向動機，但不預設既有社會科學方法普遍不足，也不預設量子形式的必要性。以下有限維狀態與測量框架沿用第 1 章的約定，其數學工具屬於標準理論［1］。

3.2 Formal Analogy Requires a Stated Correspondence3.2 形式類比需要明定對應

Definition 3.1 (Formal analogy, operational requirement). In this book, a claim of formal analogy must identify the two mathematical descriptions, a mapping between their relevant objects, and the relations or operations that the mapping preserves. If preservation is approximate, its domain and error criterion must also be specified. A shared word such as “field” or “collapse” supplies none of these conditions by itself.

定義 3.1（形式類比的操作要求）。本書使用形式類比主張時，必須指出兩種數學描述、相關物件之間的映射，以及映射保留哪些關係或運算。若只近似保留，還必須指定其適用範圍及誤差判準。僅共用「場」或「塌縮」等詞彙，本身不提供這些條件。

For example, let X and X′ be state sets, let T:X→X and T′:X′→X′ be single-step update maps, and let f:X→X′ be a proposed translation. Exact preservation of this update means

例如，令 X 與 X′ 為狀態集合，T:X→X 與 T′:X′→X′ 為單步更新映射，f:X→X′ 為所提轉譯。精確保留此更新，意指

f(T(x))=T′(f(x)),x∈X.(3.1)

Equation (3.1) is a condition to verify, not a property of every translation. A non-injective f may discard distinctions between states. Even if (3.1) holds, preservation of a particular observation requires an additional condition on the observation maps. Thus a formal correspondence does not automatically establish equivalence of empirical interpretations.

式（3.1）是需要驗證的條件，並非每個轉譯都具有的性質。非單射的 f 可能丟失狀態間的區別。即使式（3.1）成立，保留特定觀測仍需要觀測映射的額外條件。因此，形式對應不自動確立經驗詮釋的等價。

3.3 Relational Priority as a Modelling Commitment3.3 關係優先作為建模承諾

The first edition contrasted an object-first description with a relation-first description. Here, relational priority means selecting positions, interactions or shared contexts as explicit explanatory variables. It does not prove that biological persons are created by a mathematical field, nor that actor-level descriptions are always dispensable. A model must state whether its units are persons, roles, institutions or recorded events, and how these units are related.

第一版對比物件優先與關係優先的描述。本版的關係優先，意指把位置、互動或共同情境選為明確的解釋變數。這不證明生物學上的人由數學場產生，也不表示行動者層級描述總能省略。模型必須說明其單位是人、角色、制度或記錄事件，以及這些單位如何相關。

3.4 Three Levels and Their Empirical Bridge3.4 三個層次及其經驗連結

The empirical level comprises records produced by stated procedures, rather than entire institutions treated as directly measured numbers. The mathematical level specifies admissible states, transformations and predictions. The interpretive level explains which social concepts those objects are intended to represent. These levels constrain one another during model construction; social meanings should not be attached arbitrarily after a calculation is complete.

經驗層次包含依明定程序產生的紀錄，而不是把整個制度直接當作量測數字。數學層次指定允許狀態、變換與預測；詮釋層次說明這些物件意圖表示哪些社會概念。建模時三者彼此約束，不能在計算完成後才任意附加社會意義。

For a finite outcome set Y and parameters θ∈Θ, an application of Chapter 1 must specify a state ρθ​ and effects Ey,θ​ of the same dimension. They obey positivity, unit trace for the state, and completeness for the effects. The model then assigns

對有限結果集合 Y 與參數 θ∈Θ，第 1 章框架的應用必須指定同維度的狀態 ρθ​ 與效應算子 Ey,θ​。它們滿足正半定性、狀態的單位跡，以及效應算子的完備性。模型於是指派

pθ​(y)=Tr(ρθ​Ey,θ​),y∈Y.(3.2)

The study must explain how an actual record is coded as y, how parameters are estimated, and what comparison will evaluate the predictions. Multiple models may assign the same probabilities to the available observations. Formula (3.2) alone therefore establishes neither unique reconstruction nor a causal mechanism.

研究必須說明實際紀錄如何編碼為 y、參數如何估計，以及採用何種比較評估預測。多個模型可能對現有觀測指派相同機率。因此，單憑式（3.2）既不建立唯一重建，也不建立因果機制。

3.5 A Precise Example: Equivalent Representations3.5 精確例子：等價表示

Proposition 3.1 (Invariance under simultaneous unitary conjugation). Let ρ be a density matrix on Cd, let {Ey​}y∈Y​ be a finite POVM on the same space, and let U be unitary, with U†U=UU†=Id​. Define

命題 3.1（同時酉共軛下的不變性）。令 ρ 為 Cd 上的密度矩陣，{Ey​}y∈Y​ 為同一空間上的有限正算子值測量（POVM），U 為酉矩陣，滿足 U†U=UU†=Id​。定義

ρ′=UρU†,Ey′​=UEy​U†.(3.3)

Then ρ′ is a density matrix, {Ey′​} is a POVM, and every outcome probability is unchanged. This is a standard finite-dimensional algebraic fact, used here to illustrate a fully specified correspondence.

則 ρ′ 仍為密度矩陣，{Ey′​} 仍為 POVM，且每個結果的機率不變。這是標準有限維代數事實，此處用以展示完全明定的對應。

Proof. Unitary conjugation preserves Hermiticity. For every v∈Cd, positivity follows from

證明。酉共軛保留 Hermitian 性。對每個 v∈Cd，正半定性由下式得到：

v†ρ′v=(U†v)†ρ(U†v)≥0.(3.4)

The same argument applies to each effect. Cyclicity of the trace gives Tr(ρ′)=Tr(ρ)=1, and completeness gives ∑y​Ey′​=UId​U†=Id​. Finally,

相同論證適用於每個效應算子。跡的循環性給出 Tr(ρ′)=Tr(ρ)=1；完備性給出 ∑y​Ey′​=UId​U†=Id​。最後，

Tr(ρ′Ey′​)​=Tr(UρEy​U†)=Tr(ρEy​).​(3.5)

This proves the claim. Both states and effects must be transformed: changing the state while holding the measurement fixed can change predictions. The result establishes equivalence for these specified outcome probabilities; it does not classify all equivalent models or identify a social cause. It is a change of representation, not a claim about a physical intervention.

命題得證。狀態與效應必須一起變換；若只改變狀態而固定測量，預測便可能改變。此結果確立指定結果機率的等價，並未分類所有等價模型，也未辨識社會原因。這是表示的改變，不是關於物理介入的主張。

Example 3.1. In two dimensions, take ρ=diag(3/4,1/4), E0​=diag(1,0) and E1​=I2​−E0​. Let U swap the two coordinates. The transformed state is diag(1/4,3/4) and E0′​=diag(0,1). The probability of the outcome still labelled 0 remains 3/4. If only the state were swapped, that probability would instead be 1/4. These are exact illustrative calculations, not observations of a social system.

例 3.1。在二維情況，取 ρ=diag(3/4,1/4)、E0​=diag(1,0)、E1​=I2​−E0​。令 U 交換兩個座標。變換後狀態為 diag(1/4,3/4)，且 E0′​=diag(0,1)。仍標記為 0 的結果，其機率保持 3/4；若只交換狀態，該機率則變成 1/4。這些是精確示意計算，不是社會系統的觀測。

3.6 Methodological Status and Transition3.6 方法論地位與銜接

Methodological principle 3.A (Assessment by explicit commitments). Assess each model through its definitions, the validity of its derivations, the adequacy of its measurement interpretation and evidence within a declared domain. The discipline from which a formalism originates is neither sufficient support nor sufficient objection. This reformulates the first edition's “Mathematical Independence” proposition as a methodological principle; Proposition 3.1 above is a different, proved statement.

方法論原則 3.A（依明示承諾評估）。依模型的定義、推導有效性、測量詮釋的適切性，以及明定領域內的證據來評估。形式的學科來源既不足以構成支持，也不足以構成反對理由。這將第一版的「數學獨立性」命題改述為方法論原則；上文命題 3.1 則是另一項具有證明的敘述。

Adopting density matrices does not assert that social decisions are governed by microscopic quantum processes. Nor does an analogy exempt the model from empirical testing. Chapter 4's axioms must specify compatible objects and assumptions before stronger deductions are accepted. That chapter remains pending review in this working edition.

採用密度矩陣，不表示社會決策受微觀量子過程支配；類比也不使模型免於經驗檢驗。第 4 章公理必須先指定相容的物件與假設，才能接受更強推論。該章在本工作版本中仍待審訂。

Reference for Chapter 3第 3 章參考文獻

[1] Watrous, J. (2018). The Theory of Quantum Information. Cambridge University Press. Chapters 1–2: finite-dimensional operators, states and measurements. Author-hosted draft. The standard mathematical framework supports the definitions used here; it does not establish the social interpretation.

［1］Watrous（2018），《量子資訊理論》，Cambridge University Press。第 1–2 章：有限維算子、狀態與測量。連結為作者提供的草稿。標準數學框架支持此處的定義，並不確立社會詮釋。

Chapter 4 · The Eight Axioms of Social Quantum Field Theory第 4 章 · 社會量子場論的八公理

Revised draft · 已修訂草稿

4.1 Status and Scope of the Revised Axioms4.1 修訂公理的地位與範圍

The eight headings of the first edition are retained as a correspondence with its research programme, but their contents are revised into explicit modelling commitments. They combine mathematical conditions with requirements for interpretation; they are not eight independently established laws of society. The core below is finite-dimensional. Spatial fields, Fock spaces, variable subsystem structures and geometric extensions require additional definitions and are not inferred from the core.

本章保留第一版八項主題的對應，但將內容修訂為明確的建模承諾。它們結合數學條件與詮釋要求，並非八條各自已獲證實的社會定律。以下核心限定於有限維；空間場、Fock 空間、可變子系統結構與幾何擴充需要額外定義，不能由此核心直接推出。

For this chapter, let H=Cd, with integer d≥1, and let B(H) denote its linear operators. Time is measured in a declared unit. State, channel and measurement conventions follow the standard finite-dimensional framework [1]. Table 4.1 summarizes the revised commitments; Sections 4.6 and 4.11 supply the proofs needed for the principal mathematical claims.

本章令 H=Cd，其中整數 d≥1，並以 B(H) 表示其線性算子。時間採明定單位。狀態、通道與測量約定沿用標準有限維框架［1］。表 4.1 概括修訂承諾；第 4.6 與 4.11 節提供主要數學主張所需的證明。

4.2 Axiom I — Relational Specification4.2 公理 I — 明定關係描述

An application must declare its observational units, context, time scale and the relations it intends to model. Relational priority is the methodological decision to include these relations explicitly; it is not a temporal or causal ordering between a field and a person. The first edition's judge example illustrates a distinction between a person and an institutional role, rather than a derivation of the person from a field operator.

應用必須明定觀測單位、情境、時間尺度及欲建模的關係。關係優先是明確納入這些關係的方法論決定，不是場與人之間的時間或因果先後。第一版的法官例子說明人與制度角色的區分，而非由場算子推導出人的存在。

4.3 Axiom II — Admissible States and Local Descriptions4.3 公理 II — 允許狀態與局部描述

A state is a density operator in the set

狀態是下列集合中的密度算子：

D(H)={ρ∈B(H):ρ=ρ†, ρ≥0, Trρ=1}.(4.1)

An actor or role is an interpreted observational unit, not an operator or a vector by definition. If a later extension constructs a nonzero vector by applying an operator to a reference vector, its domain and normalization must be specified. The expression used in the first edition for a “local excitation” is therefore not imposed as a universal identity in this finite core. Local descriptions are supplied by observation maps or by reductions under Axiom III.

行動者或角色是經過詮釋的觀測單位，並非依定義就是算子或向量。若後續擴充以算子作用於參考向量來建構非零向量，必須指定定義域及正規化。因此，第一版的「局域激發」表達式，不在本有限維核心中強制列為普遍恆等式。局部描述由觀測映射或公理 III 的約化提供。

4.4 Axiom III — Composition with Possible Dependence4.4 公理 III — 容許相依的組合

When a model identifies two subsystems, it must declare a factorization H=HA​⊗HB​. The joint state may be any specified element of D(H); its local states are ρA​=TrB​ρ and ρB​=TrA​ρ. Product states are allowed. Dependence is not forced merely by calling the units social actors.

模型辨識兩個子系統時，必須明定分解 H=HA​⊗HB​。聯合狀態可取 D(H) 中指定的元素；局部狀態為 ρA​=TrB​ρ 與 ρB​=TrA​ρ。乘積狀態也被允許，不能只因把單位稱為社會行動者，就強制要求相依。

A mixed state is separable when it is a convex mixture of product density operators [1, Chapter 6]. A state that is not a single product can nevertheless be separable. Thus the non-product condition, quantum entanglement and sociological interdependence must not be used interchangeably. The classical shared-context model of Chapter 2 remains an admissible baseline.

混態若為乘積密度算子的凸混合，則稱為可分態［1，第 6 章］。不是單一乘積的狀態，仍可能是可分態。因此，非乘積條件、量子糾纏與社會學相互依存，不可交替當作同一概念。第 2 章的經典共同情境模型仍是允許的基準。

4.5 Axiom IV — Observations and Contextual Capital4.5 公理 IV — 觀測與情境資本

A finite observation is specified by effects Ey​≥0 with ∑y​Ey​=Id​. Outcome probabilities are p(y)=Tr(ρEy​). If outcomes carry real scores cy​, their expected score is obtained from C=∑y​cy​Ey​:

有限觀測由效應算子 Ey​≥0 指定，且 ∑y​Ey​=Id​。結果機率為 p(y)=Tr(ρEy​)。若結果具有實數評分 cy​，則由 C=∑y​cy​Ey​ 得到期望評分：

E[c]=y∑​cy​p(y)=Tr(ρC).(4.2)

Calling this score “capital”, “power” or “trust” requires an operational justification. Actor, resource category and contextual valuation must be distinguished as in Chapter 2. These labels do not determine operators by themselves, and capital is not assumed to depend on context alone. For a nonnegative score, choose cy​≥0; a general signed score need not yield a positive operator.

將此評分稱為「資本」、「權力」或「信任」，需要操作上的論證。如第 2 章所述，必須區分行動者、資源類別與情境評價。標籤本身不能決定算子，也不假設資本只依賴情境。若評分應非負，則取 cy​≥0；一般有正負號的評分不必產生正算子。

4.6 Axiom V — Conditional and Unconditional Updates4.6 公理 V — 條件與非條件更新

An outcome-resolved update is specified by a finite instrument {Iy​}: each Iy​ is a linear completely positive, trace-nonincreasing map on B(H), and their sum is trace preserving. For the associated observation, require TrIy​(ρ)=Tr(ρEy​). A POVM alone does not determine the instrument. Given an outcome with positive probability,

區分結果的更新由有限儀器 {Iy​} 指定：各 Iy​ 是 B(H) 上線性、完全正且跡不增加的映射，其總和保持跡。對相應觀測，要求 TrIy​(ρ)=Tr(ρEy​)。僅有 POVM 並不能決定儀器。對機率為正的已知結果，

py​=TrIy​(ρ),ρy​=py​Iy​(ρ)​,py​>0.(4.3)

If the result is discarded, the state is instead ρ′=∑y​Iy​(ρ). An institutional transition need not be a projective measurement; the proposed update and its empirical interpretation must be justified separately.

若不保留結果，狀態則為 ρ′=∑y​Iy​(ρ)。制度轉變未必是投影測量，所提更新及其經驗詮釋必須分別論證。

Proposition 4.1 (Normalized projective conditioning). Let P=P†=P2 and ρ∈D(H). If p=Tr(Pρ)>0, then

命題 4.1（正規化的投影條件更新）。令 P=P†=P2，且 ρ∈D(H)。若 p=Tr(Pρ)>0，則

ρP​=Tr(Pρ)PρP​∈D(H).(4.4)

Proof. The numerator is Hermitian and positive semidefinite, since v†PρPv=(Pv)†ρ(Pv)≥0 for every vector v. Cyclicity and P2=P give Tr(PρP)=Tr(Pρ)=p. Dividing by the positive number p preserves positivity and gives unit trace. If p=0, this conditional update is undefined. Thus the first edition's unnormalized numerator cannot generally be called the posterior density operator.

證明。分子為 Hermitian 且正半定，因為對每個向量 v，有 v†PρPv=(Pv)†ρ(Pv)≥0。由跡的循環性與 P2=P 得 Tr(PρP)=Tr(Pρ)=p。除以正數 p 保留正半定性，且使跡為一。若 p=0，此條件更新未定義。因此，不能一般地把第一版未正規化的分子稱為更新後密度算子。

For the two-dimensional state ρ=I2​/2 and P=diag(1,0), the numerator has trace 1/2; the normalized posterior is P. This exact example displays the missing factor without making any empirical claim.

對二維狀態 ρ=I2​/2 及 P=diag(1,0)，分子的跡為 1/2；正規化後的狀態為 P。此精確例子展示缺少的因子，不提出任何實證主張。

4.7 Axiom VI — Explicit Structural Descriptors4.7 公理 VI — 明確的結構描述量

If topology is used, an application must specify the graph, complex or topological space being described, the descriptor and the allowed transformations. A density matrix alone does not supply a unique social topology. A descriptor may remain constant or change; neither outcome is required at every time step. For example, the number of connected components of a declared graph is a well-defined descriptor, but its relation to performance requires additional evidence.

應用若使用拓撲，必須指定所描述的圖、複形或拓撲空間、描述量及允許的變換。單一密度矩陣不提供唯一的社會拓撲。描述量可能保持不變，也可能改變；不要求每個時間步都必然發生其中某種變化。例如，明定圖的連通分量數是定義良好的描述量，但它與表現的關係需要額外證據。

4.8 Axiom VII — Valid Dynamics and Optional Markov Semigroups4.8 公理 VII — 合法動力學與選用的 Markov 半群

For an unconditional update represented as a linear map on the full operator space, the finite core uses completely positive trace-preserving (CPTP) channels. Complete positivity means positivity is retained after tensoring the map with an identity map of any finite dimension. This is a modelling restriction; openness alone does not establish it for every reduced description with arbitrary initial correlations, nor does it imply a Markov semigroup.

對表示為完整算子空間上線性映射的非條件更新，本有限維核心採用完全正且保持跡（CPTP）的通道。完全正意指把映射與任意有限維恆等映射作張量積後，仍保留正性。這是建模限制；開放性本身不證成任意初始關聯下每種約化描述都符合此限制，也不蘊含 Markov 半群。

If a time-homogeneous, norm-continuous CPTP semigroup is additionally assumed, with E0​=id and Et+s​=Et​Es​ for t,s≥0, its finite-dimensional generator has the Lindblad form [2]:

若額外假設時間齊次、範數連續的 CPTP 半群，滿足 E0​=id，且對 t,s≥0 有 Et+s​=Et​Es​，其有限維生成元具有 Lindblad 形式［2］：

dtdρ​=−i[K,ρ]+k∑​(Lk​ρLk†​−21​{Lk†​Lk​,ρ}).(4.5)

Here K=K† has units of inverse time, Lk​ has units of inverse square-root time, [A,B]=AB−BA and {A,B}=AB+BA. No universal social value of Planck's constant is assumed. This is a frequency-generator convention; any later use of an energy-like Hamiltonian must state its conversion. Memory-dependent models and changing state spaces require separate constructions.

此處 K=K† 的單位為時間的倒數，Lk​ 的單位為時間平方根的倒數，[A,B]=AB−BA，{A,B}=AB+BA。不假設存在普遍的社會 Planck 常數。這是頻率生成元的約定；後文若使用類能量的哈密頓量，必須說明換算。具記憶的模型與改變狀態空間的情況，需要另外建構。

4.9 Axiom VIII — Interpretation and Testability4.9 公理 VIII — 詮釋與可檢驗性

Every application must identify the observation procedure, parameter meaning and intended domain, and distinguish proved mathematical results from empirical hypotheses and illustrative examples. A finite matrix construction demonstrates mathematical admissibility, not that a social system follows it. Formal analogy must meet the correspondence requirements of Chapter 3. Quantum terminology alone is neither evidence of microscopic quantum behavior nor evidence of predictive advantage.

每項應用必須交代觀測程序、參數意義與預定適用範圍，並區分已證數學結果、經驗假說及示意例子。有限矩陣建構展示數學上的合法性，不證明社會系統遵循它。形式類比必須符合第 3 章的對應要求。量子術語本身既不是微觀量子行為的證據，也不是預測優勢的證據。

The first edition's dependency diagram organized themes; its arrows were not deductions. Table 4.1 replaces that diagram with explicit requirements. In particular, contextual roles do not entail entanglement, and topology does not entail Lindblad dynamics.

Proof. The diagonal entries of ρ0​ are nonnegative and sum to one. Its marginals are both I2​/2, while ρ0​=I4​/4, so it is correlated. The score operator is C=P00​+P11​, with initial expectation one.

Thus R is CPTP, and (4.7) is a convex mixture of CPTP maps. Since R2=R, direct composition gives Et​Es​=Et+s​; continuity and the identity at zero follow from the exponential. 因此 R 為 CPTP，式（4.7）是 CPTP 映射的凸混合。由 R2=R，直接組合可得 Et​Es​=Et+s​；連續性與零時恆等性由指數函數得到。在式（4.5）取 K=0、Ljk​=γ​Vjk​，即得到所需生成元 γ(R−id)。有限實現得證，但不證成經驗適切性或每項後續擴充的相容性。

An exact consequence useful for checking this example is Tr(Et​(ρ0​)C)=(1+e−γt)/2. The supplementary verification script in Appendix 4.A checks selected rational mixing weights and the matrix identities; it is a reproducible algebra check, not an empirical simulation or a substitute for the proof.

Chapter 5 · A Worked Model of Relational Coordination in Football 第 5 章 · 足球關係協調的可計算模型

Revised draft · 已修訂草稿

5.1 Scope of the example 5.1 例子的範圍

The first-edition phrase “Quantum Entanglement Pass” motivated a fictional football example. Here the example becomes an explicit classical shared-context model embedded in the finite-dimensional framework of Chapter 4. We calculate its joint distribution, density operator, mutual information, conditional update and prediction performance. All numerical values are consequences of declared assumptions; no match data or empirical findings are reported.

第一版以「量子纏結傳球」的意象引入虛構足球例子。本章將它改為明確的古典共同情境模型，並嵌入第 4 章的有限維框架。我們計算其聯合分布、密度算子、互資訊、條件更新及預測表現。所有數值均由明示假設推得；本章未使用比賽資料，也未報告實證發現。

5.2 Observations and the alignment score 5.2 觀察量與方向一致分數

Consider one eligible passing opportunity with two coded records: the passer's target lane A∈{0,1} and the receiver's run lane B∈{0,1}. Both use the same declared left/right reference frame and observation window. The binary coding excludes other actions; eligibility and coding must be defined before collecting data. These variables label records, not the players' complete physical or cognitive states.

考慮一次符合納入條件的傳球機會，記錄兩個編碼值：傳球者的目標路線 A∈{0,1} 與接球者的跑動路線 B∈{0,1}。兩者採用同一個明示的左／右參照座標與觀察時間窗。二元編碼不包含其他行動，因此必須在蒐集資料前訂定納入與編碼規則。這些變數標示的是紀錄，而非球員完整的物理或認知狀態。

Definition 5.1 (Directional alignment). The trial score is one when the two coded lanes match and zero otherwise. Its expectation is denoted by Salign​. This is a narrowly defined proxy for coordination; a matched direction need not produce a completed pass, a safe tactical choice or a goal.

定義 5.1（方向一致）。 兩個路線編碼相同時，單次分數為一，否則為零；其期望值記為 Salign​。這是範圍有限的協調代理指標；方向一致並不保證傳球成功、戰術安全或進球。

c(a,b)=1{a=b}​,Salign​=E[c(A,B)]=Pr(A=B).(5.1)

5.3 A shared-context generative model 5.3 共同情境生成模型

Assume a shared tactical cue Z takes either binary value with probability one half. Independent noise variables NA​,NB​ each equal one with probability ε∈[0,1/2]; they are also independent of Z. A noise value of one reverses the cue. The symbol ⊕ denotes addition modulo two. These assumptions specify the model completely for one opportunity.

假設共同戰術線索 Z 以各二分之一的機率取兩個二元值。雜訊變數 NA​,NB​ 彼此獨立，且各以機率 ε∈[0,1/2] 取一；它們也都與 Z 獨立。雜訊值為一時會反轉線索。符號 ⊕ 表示模二加法。這些假設完整指定了單次機會的模型。

ZNA​,NB​A​∼Bernoulli(1/2),∼Bernoulli(ε)independently,=Z⊕NA​,B=Z⊕NB​.​(5.2)

Figure 5.1 records the assumed mechanism. Conditional on the cue, the two records are independent; after averaging over the cue, they can be dependent. Classical probability and graphical models already permit this structure. The absence of a direct arrow between the records is a modelling assumption, not a finding that players never communicate.

圖 5.1 呈現所假設的機制。給定線索後，兩個紀錄彼此獨立；對線索取平均後，兩者卻可能相依。古典機率與圖模型本來就容許這種結構。兩個紀錄之間沒有直接箭頭，是模型假設，不是球員從不溝通的研究發現。

Proposition 5.1 (Joint law and alignment). Under Equation (5.2), let r=2ε(1−ε). The joint law and alignment score are given by Equation (5.3). Each marginal is uniform, so the independent model with the same marginals has alignment score one half.

pab​p00​=p11​Salign​​=Pr(A=a,B=b),0≤r≤21​,=21−r​,p01​=p10​=2r​,=1−r,Salign​−21​=21​(1−2ε)2.​(5.3)

Proof. The records differ exactly when the noise values differ, which has probability 2ε(1−ε). 5.5 Density representation and separability 5.5 密度表示與可分性

Use the ordered basis ∣00⟩,∣01⟩,∣10⟩,∣11⟩ of HA​⊗HB​=C2⊗C2. The diagonal embedding below is positive semidefinite and has trace one, since its diagonal entries are nonnegative and sum to one. Its explicit convex decomposition into product states proves separability in the standard sense [1, Section 6.1.1]. Thus the example can have dependence without entanglement.

使用 HA​⊗HB​=C2⊗C2 的有序基底 ∣00⟩,∣01⟩,∣10⟩,∣11⟩。以下對角嵌入為半正定且跡為一，因為對角元素非負且總和為一。它明確寫成乘積態的凸組合，依標準定義即證明可分性［1，第 6.1.1 節］。因此，本例可以有相依性而沒有纏結。

ρε​TrB​ρε​​=diag(21−r​,2r​,2r​,21−r​)=a,b=0∑1​pab​(∣a⟩⟨a∣)⊗(∣b⟩⟨b∣),=TrA​ρε​=I2​/2.​(5.4)

A product of these marginals is I4​/4. Equation (5.4) equals that product only when r=1/2, equivalently ε=1/2 in the declared domain. Otherwise it is a non-product but separable state. In particular, the same local marginals occur at every noise level, while the joint alignment score changes. Local marginals alone therefore do not specify the joint score.

這兩個邊際的乘積為 I4​/4。式（5.4）僅在 r=1/2 時等於該乘積；在已指定的定義域內，這等價於 ε=1/2。其餘情況都是非乘積但可分的狀態。尤其，各雜訊水準具有相同的局部邊際，聯合方向一致分數卻會改變。因此，僅憑局部邊際無法決定聯合分數。

5.6 Mutual information measures dependence 5.6 互資訊衡量相依性

Use logarithms to base two, so entropy is measured in bits, with the convention 0log2​0=0. For this diagonal state the von Neumann entropy equals the Shannon entropy of the four probabilities. The standard entropy definitions [1, Sections 5.1.1 and 5.2.1] give:

使用以二為底的對數，因此熵的單位為位元，並約定 0log2​0=0。對本對角態，von Neumann 熵等於四個機率的 Shannon 熵。依標準熵定義［1，第 5.1.1 與 5.2.1 節］可得：

h2​(r)S(ρε​)I(A:B)​=−rlog2​r−(1−r)log2​(1−r),=1+h2​(r),=S(ρA​)+S(ρB​)−S(ρε​)=1−h2​(r).​(5.5)

Derivation. There are two eigenvalues equal to (1−r)/2 and two equal to r/2. Substituting them into the entropy sum yields 1+h2​(r). Each marginal has two eigenvalues equal to one half and hence entropy one. Subtracting the joint entropy proves Equation (5.5), including the endpoints by the zero-log convention. The mutual information is one bit at zero noise and zero at noise one half. It measures total dependence here; it neither detects entanglement nor establishes a causal coaching benefit. Outside this restricted model, dependence can also reflect disagreement or an unhelpful shared constraint.

推導。 有兩個特徵值等於 (1−r)/2，另兩個等於 r/2；代入熵的加總式，得到 1+h2​(r)。各邊際有兩個均為二分之一的特徵值，因此熵為一。相減即證得式（5.5），端點則依零對數約定處理。雜訊為零時互資訊為一位元，雜訊為二分之一時為零。它在此衡量總相依性，既不偵測纏結，也不確立教練介入的因果效益。在這個受限模型之外，相依性也可能反映意見相反或無助於任務的共同限制。

5.7 Coaching as a testable extension 5.7 教練介入作為待驗證擴充

Training might alter the noise parameter, cue distribution or coding-relevant behavior, but this chapter does not derive or estimate such effects. Calling a coach an external Hamiltonian supplies neither a matrix nor a dynamical law. A control model would need a specified state space, control inputs, transition rule and intervention evidence. The present static model supplies none of those empirical conclusions.

訓練可能改變雜訊參數、線索分布或與編碼相關的行為，但本章未推導或估計這些效果。稱教練為外部哈密頓量，並未提供矩陣或動力法則。控制模型需要指定狀態空間、控制輸入、轉移規則與介入證據。目前的靜態模型不提供這些實證結論。

5.8 Tactical descriptors and mathematical structure 5.8 戰術描述量與數學結構

Position, role, defensive pressure and stamina could be added as observed context variables. A list of descriptors does not by itself define a smooth manifold, metric or projection map. We therefore use a finite record space in this worked example. A geometric extension must define its objects and show what additional prediction they support before it is used to explain the records.

位置、角色、防守壓力與體能可以加入模型，作為觀測到的情境變數。但列出描述量，本身並不定義光滑流形、度量或投影映射。因此，本工作例子採用有限紀錄空間。幾何擴充必須先定義其物件，並說明能支持哪些額外預測，才能用於解釋紀錄。

5.9 Measurement and conditional updating 5.9 測量與條件更新

The joint projectors Pab​=∣ab⟩⟨ab∣ sum to the identity, and Tr(ρε​Pab​)=pab​. To learn only that the target lane is zero, use the projector P0A​=∣0⟩⟨0∣⊗I2​. The normalized conditional state is:

聯合投影算子 Pab​=∣ab⟩⟨ab∣ 的總和為單位算子，且 Tr(ρε​Pab​)=pab​。若只得知目標路線為零，使用投影算子 P0A​=∣0⟩⟨0∣⊗I2​。正規化條件態為：

Pr(A=0)ρε​∣A=0​​=Tr(P0A​ρε​)=21​,=Tr(P0A​ρε​)P0A​ρε​P0A​​=diag(1−r,r,0,0).​(5.6)

Verification. Projection retains the first two diagonal entries, whose sum is one half. Dividing by that probability yields the displayed nonnegative, trace-one state. For any other event the same rule requires positive event probability; a zero-probability event has no conditional state under this rule. If the target-lane outcome is discarded, summing the two projected branches returns the original diagonal state. Here selection updates information about records; it does not prove that executing a pass physically produces quantum collapse.

驗算。 投影保留前兩個對角元素，其總和為二分之一。除以該機率後，即得所列非負且跡為一的狀態。其他事件套用相同規則時，也必須具有正機率；零機率事件在此規則下沒有條件態。若不保留目標路線結果，對兩個投影分支加總便回到原對角態。在此，篩選更新的是紀錄資訊，並不證明執行傳球會物理地產生量子塌縮。

5.10 Relation to the preceding dynamical example 5.10 與前章動力例子的關係

The states also lie on the depolarizing family constructed in Proposition 4.2. Let ρ0​=diag(1/2,0,0,1/2) and define the dimensionless weight λ=(1−2ε)2. Direct substitution gives:

這些狀態也位於命題 4.2 建構的去極化族上。令 ρ0​=diag(1/2,0,0,1/2)，並定義無因次權重 λ=(1−2ε)2，直接代入可得：

ρε​=λρ0​+(1−λ)4I4​​,Salign​=21+λ​.(5.7)

The matching entries are (1+λ)/4=(1−r)/2 and the mismatching entries are (1−λ)/4=r/2, proving the identity. Choosing λ=e−γt recovers the trajectory of Chapter 4, but that time law remains an additional assumption. This algebraic correspondence establishes neither actual fatigue dynamics nor a coaching law. Changes between plays require a separately specified temporal model.

相同結果的元素為 (1+λ)/4=(1−r)/2，不同結果的元素為 (1−λ)/4=r/2，因而證得等式。選取 λ=e−γt 可回復第 4 章的軌跡，但該時間法則仍是額外假設。此代數對應既不確立真實疲勞動力學，也不確立教練介入法則。不同回合之間的變化需要另行指定時間模型。

5.11 A prediction theorem with declared information 5.11 明定資訊條件的預測定理

Proposition 5.2 (Value of observing a correlated record). A predictor knows the model and must guess B with zero–one loss. Without observing A or any other informative variable, its best success probability is one half. After observing A, the rule g(A)=A is optimal and succeeds with probability 1−r. Randomization independent of the model variables cannot improve either optimum.

命題 5.2（觀察相關紀錄的價值）。 預測者知道模型，並須在零一損失下猜測 B。若未觀察 A 或其他帶有資訊的變數，最佳猜中機率為二分之一。觀察 A 後，規則 g(A)=A 為最優，猜中機率為 1−r。與模型變數獨立的隨機化無法改善任一最優值。

Pr(B=a∣A=a)Pr(B=1−a∣A=a)gmax​Pr(g(A)=B)​=1−r,=r,a∈{0,1},=1−r.​(5.8)

Proof. Without informative observations, either fixed guess succeeds with probability one half because B is uniform. An independent randomized guess is a mixture of these equal success probabilities. With A=a, dividing the joint entries by the marginal one half gives the first two lines of Equation (5.8). Since r≤1/2, guessing a maximizes conditional success. A randomized guess forms a convex combination of r and 1−r, which cannot exceed the larger value. Averaging over A gives 1−r. When r=1/2, both guesses tie; otherwise g(a)=a is the unique maximizing deterministic choice at each observation. This proves the proposition.

證明。 沒有帶有資訊的觀察時，因 B 為均勻分布，任一固定猜測均以二分之一機率猜中。獨立的隨機猜測只是這些相同成功率的混合。得知 A=a 後，以邊際機率二分之一除聯合分布元素，即得式（5.8）的前兩行。由於 r≤1/2，猜測 a 會最大化條件成功率。隨機猜測形成 r 與 1−r 的凸組合，不可能超過較大者。對 A 取平均即得 1−r。當 r=1/2 時，兩種猜測並列最優；其餘情況下，g(a)=a 是每個觀察值下唯一的最優確定性選擇。命題得證。

This is a prediction result for a fixed joint law. It is not an optimal passing policy: an intervention that chooses the passer's lane could change the receiver's response and requires a causal model. The first-edition proof incorrectly inferred state factorization from local optimality. For example, if a decision problem rewards one fixed action in every state, that action is locally optimal even when the underlying state is entangled. State structure alone therefore cannot establish a claim about optimal strategy without a specified reward and information structure.

這是在固定聯合分布下的預測結果，並非最優傳球政策：選擇傳球路線的介入可能改變接球者反應，因此需要因果模型。第一版的證明錯誤地由局部最優性推出狀態因子化。例如，若決策問題在每個狀態都獎勵同一固定行動，即使底層狀態具有纏結，該行動仍可在局部資訊下最優。因此，未指定報酬與資訊結構時，僅憑狀態結構不能確立最優策略的主張。

5.12 Empirical scope and next tests 5.12 實證範圍與後續檢驗

An empirical study would first define eligible opportunities, the left/right frame, the timing of both records and the information available before prediction. It would assess coding reliability, missing records and whether uniform marginals and symmetric errors are plausible. Repeated opportunities in a match may be dependent; the single-opportunity model does not assert independent sampling. Evaluation should keep entire matches separate between training and testing, and account for dependence when quantifying uncertainty.

實證研究首先須定義符合納入條件的機會、左／右座標、兩個紀錄的時間，以及預測前可用的資訊。接著評估編碼可靠度、缺漏紀錄，以及均勻邊際與對稱誤差是否合理。同場比賽的多次機會可能相依；單次機會模型並未主張取樣獨立。評估時應以整場比賽區分訓練與測試資料，並在量化不確定性時處理相依性。

The uniform independent baseline is appropriate for this toy model. With nonuniform observed marginals, the corresponding independent alignment benchmark must instead use the fitted marginal probabilities. Stronger classical baselines should include observed shared context and relevant history. Held-out predictive accuracy, probability calibration and log loss can then assess whether a proposed extension adds value; no such comparison has been run here.

均勻獨立基準適用於本玩具模型。若觀察到的邊際不均勻，對應的獨立方向一致基準必須改用估計的邊際機率。更強的古典基準應納入已觀測的共同情境與相關歷史。之後可用保留資料的預測準確率、機率校準與對數損失，評估擴充是否增加價值；本章尚未執行這類比較。

Sind​=a=0∑1​pA​(a)pB​(a).(5.9)

The four observed frequencies identify a joint distribution under a sampling model and therefore its chosen diagonal embedding. They do not identify an arbitrary density matrix: the fixed projectors read only its diagonal, leaving possible off-diagonal entries undetermined. They also do not identify a unique latent cue mechanism or coaching effect. A genuinely broader operator model would require specified additional measurements and predictions that distinguish it from suitable classical alternatives. The calculations here demonstrate a consistent, reproducible relational example while leaving those empirical questions open.

四種結果的觀察頻率可在取樣模型下識別聯合分布，因而識別所選的對角嵌入，但無法識別任意密度矩陣：固定投影只讀取對角線，可能存在的非對角元素仍無法確定。它們也無法識別唯一的潛在線索機制或教練效果。更廣的算子模型須指定額外測量，以及可將其與適當古典替代方案區別的預測。此處計算展示一致且可重現的關係例子，並保留上述實證問題。

Chapter 6 · Social Hilbert Space and the Geometry of Relational Possibility 第 6 章 · 社會希爾伯特空間與關係可能性的幾何

Revised draft · 已修訂草稿

6.1 A finite state space and its basis 6.1 有限狀態空間與基底

Definition 6.1 (Finite social Hilbert representation). Fix an integer d≥1 and use HS​=Cd with its usual complex inner product, conjugate-linear in the first argument. The dimension, coordinate labels and connection to recorded outcomes are modelling choices. Completeness is automatic in finite dimension. This construction represents a specified application; it is not a theorem that every social configuration has a unique vector representation.

定義 6.1（有限社會 Hilbert 表示）。 固定整數 d≥1，採用 HS​=Cd 及其通常的複內積，內積對第一個引數為共軛線性。維度、座標標籤與紀錄結果的連結均屬建模選擇；有限維空間自動具有完備性。此建構表示一項指定應用，並非每個社會配置都有唯一向量表示的定理。

Definition 6.2 (Orthonormal basis). Choose d vectors satisfying Equation (6.1). They provide coordinates for the representation. If their labels are to denote mutually exclusive observed categories, a measurement rule must also be specified. Labels alone do not establish orthogonality or an empirical interpretation.

定義 6.2（正交歸一基底）。 選取滿足式（6.1）的 d 個向量，為此表示提供座標。若其標籤要代表互斥的觀察類別，還須指定測量規則。單靠標籤不能確立正交性或實證詮釋。

⟨ei​∣ej​⟩=δij​,i=1∑d​∣ei​⟩⟨ei​∣=Id​.(6.1)

A unit vector has unique complex coordinates in this fixed basis. In the corresponding projective measurement, the squared magnitudes, rather than the amplitudes themselves, are the probabilities. This finite state-and-measurement convention follows the standard framework [1, Chapter 2].

單位向量在此固定基底下具有唯一的複數座標。在對應的投影測量中，機率是振幅的模平方，而非振幅本身。此有限狀態與測量約定沿用標準框架［1，第 2 章］。

∣ψ⟩⟨ψ∣ψ⟩p(i)​=i=1∑d​ci​∣ei​⟩,ci​=⟨ei​∣ψ⟩,=i=1∑d​∣ci​∣2=1,=⟨ψ∣ei​⟩⟨ei​∣ψ⟩=∣ci​∣2.​(6.2)

Definition 6.3 (State and pure-state representative). A general state is a density operator ρ∈D(HS​), as in Chapter 1. A unit vector represents the pure state ρψ​=∣ψ⟩⟨ψ∣. Multiplication of the vector by a global phase leaves this operator and every Born probability unchanged. Pure states therefore correspond to rays, not unique unit vectors. Mixed states are included through density operators and need not admit a single-vector representation.

定義 6.3（狀態與純態代表）。 一般狀態是第 1 章所定義的密度算子 ρ∈D(HS​)。單位向量表示純態 ρψ​=∣ψ⟩⟨ψ∣。將向量乘上整體相位，不會改變此算子或任何 Born 機率。因此，純態對應射線，而非唯一的單位向量。混態以密度算子納入，不一定能用單一向量表示。

6.2 Inner product and equality conditions 6.2 內積與等號條件

Definition 6.4 (Norm). The norm is ∥ψ∥=⟨ψ∣ψ⟩​. Proposition 6.1 (Overlap of unit vectors). If both vectors are normalized, Equation (6.3) holds. Its upper equality characterizes the same ray; its lower equality characterizes orthogonal vectors.

定義 6.4（範數）。 範數為 ∥ψ∥=⟨ψ∣ψ⟩​。命題 6.1（單位向量的重疊）。 若兩個向量均已歸一化，則式（6.3）成立。上界的等號表示同一射線；下界的等號表示向量正交。

0≤∣⟨ϕ∣ψ⟩∣≤1,∣⟨ϕ∣ψ⟩∣=1 ⟺ ∣ψ⟩=eiθ∣ϕ⟩(θ∈R).(6.3)

Proof. Cauchy–Schwarz gives ∣⟨ϕ∣ψ⟩∣≤∥ϕ∥∥ψ∥=1. Equality holds exactly when the nonzero vectors are linearly dependent; their unit norms force the proportionality constant to have modulus one. Zero overlap is the definition of orthogonality. These are mathematical relations in the chosen representation. Equating them with identical or socially unrelated configurations requires a separate measurement and interpretation argument.

證明。 Cauchy–Schwarz 不等式給出 ∣⟨ϕ∣ψ⟩∣≤∥ϕ∥∥ψ∥=1。等號恰在兩個非零向量線性相依時成立；單位範數使比例常數的模必須為一。重疊為零即為正交的定義。這些是所選表示中的數學關係；若要將其等同於相同或社會上無關的配置，仍須另外提供測量與詮釋論證。

6.3 Superposition and its normalization 6.3 疊加及其歸一化

Definition 6.5 (Normalized superposition). Given unit vectors and complex coefficients, first form the vector ∣v⟩ below. If it is nonzero, divide by its norm to obtain a pure-state representative. The norm contains an overlap term; normalization of the two inputs does not remove it.

定義 6.5（歸一化疊加）。 給定單位向量與複係數，先形成以下向量 ∣v⟩；若其非零，再除以範數得到純態代表。範數包含重疊項，兩個輸入各自歸一化並不會消除此項。

∣v⟩∥v∥2∣ψ⟩​=α∣ψ1​⟩+β∣ψ2​⟩,=∣α∣2+∣β∣2+2Re(α∗β⟨ψ1​∣ψ2​⟩),=∥v∥∣v⟩​when ∥v∥>0.​(6.4)

Derivation. Expanding the inner product of the sum with itself produces two diagonal terms and two complex-conjugate cross terms, giving Equation (6.4). Thus ∣α∣2+∣β∣2=1 suffices when the real cross term vanishes, in particular for orthogonal inputs. It is not sufficient for arbitrary inputs. A zero sum cannot be normalized and must be excluded.

推導。 將向量和與自身的內積展開，得到兩個對角項及兩個互為共軛的交叉項，即得式（6.4）。因此，只有在實交叉項為零時，∣α∣2+∣β∣2=1 才足以保證歸一化，正交輸入尤其符合此條件。對任意輸入則不充分。零向量和無法歸一化，必須排除。

∣ψ1​⟩∣v⟩​=(10​),=(27/2516/25​),​∣ψ2​⟩∥v∥2​=(3/54/5​),=125197​.​α=3/5,β=4/5,(6.5)

The exact normalized vector below gives basis-measurement probabilities one half, one quarter and one quarter. 例 6.1（三個有標籤的選項）。 在示意性的三維模型中，將「4-3-3」、「4-4-2」與「3-5-2」陣型標籤指派給一組正交歸一基底。以下精確歸一化向量給出二分之一、四分之一與四分之一的基底測量機率。第一版係數 0.71 是 1/2​ 的捨入近似；若將其視為精確值，範數平方會是 1.0041。標籤本身不確立足球中的相干疊加；使用相同機率的對角混合也會給出相同的基底測量結果。

6.4 Density operators, mixtures and measurement 6.4 密度算子、混合與測量

Definition 6.6 (Density operator). The state set is given below. Every finite ensemble of unit vectors with nonnegative weights summing to one defines a density operator; conversely, the spectral decomposition of any density operator supplies such an ensemble. A density operator is pure precisely when it has rank one.

定義 6.6（密度算子）。 狀態集合如下。任何由單位向量組成、權重非負且總和為一的有限系綜，都定義一個密度算子；反之，任意密度算子的譜分解都提供此類系綜。密度算子恰在秩為一時是純態。

D(HS​)ρ​={ρ∈Cd×d:ρ=ρ†, ρ⪰0, Trρ=1},=k=1∑m​pk​∣ψk​⟩⟨ψk​∣,pk​≥0,k=1∑m​pk​=1.​(6.7)

Proposition 6.2 (Ensemble validity). The ensemble expression in Equation (6.7) is Hermitian because each summand is Hermitian. For every vector x, its quadratic form is ⟨x∣ρ∣x⟩=∑k​pk​∣⟨ψk​∣x⟩∣2≥0. Its trace is ∑k​pk​∥ψk​∥2=1. Conversely, the spectral theorem gives an orthonormal eigenbasis, nonnegative eigenvalues and eigenvalue sum one; these are the required ensemble vectors and weights. A rank-one density operator consequently has its sole nonzero eigenvalue equal to one and is a unit-vector projector.

命題 6.2（系綜的合法性）。 式（6.7）的系綜表示為 Hermitian，因為每一加總項皆為 Hermitian。對任意向量 x，其二次型為 ⟨x∣ρ∣x⟩=∑k​pk​∣⟨ψk​∣x⟩∣2≥0。其跡為 ∑k​pk​∥ψk​∥2=1。反之，譜定理提供正交歸一特徵基底、非負特徵值與為一的特徵值總和，正是所需的系綜向量與權重。因此，秩一密度算子唯一的非零特徵值必為一，且為單位向量投影。

An ensemble decomposition is generally not unique. In two dimensions define ∣±⟩=(∣0⟩±∣1⟩)/2​, ρ±​=∣±⟩⟨±∣ and ρmix​=I2​/2. Equal mixtures of the two basis projectors or of ρ+​,ρ−​ both give ρmix​. A density operator therefore does not identify a unique hidden list of preparations.

系綜分解通常不唯一。在二維中，定義 ∣±⟩=(∣0⟩±∣1⟩)/2​、ρ±​=∣±⟩⟨±∣ 與 ρmix​=I2​/2。對兩個基底投影作等權混合，或對 ρ+​,ρ−​ 作等權混合，都得到 ρmix​。因此，密度算子不能識別唯一的隱藏製備清單。

Table 6.1 compares three states under two specified projective measurements: the basis measurement with outcome projector P0​=∣0⟩⟨0∣, and another with outcome projector P+​=∣+⟩⟨+∣. Each projector is accompanied by its complementary projector. The probabilities follow by multiplying the matrices or taking squared overlaps. The two measurement settings are mathematical constructions; implementing their social analogues requires a defined observation protocol.

表 6.1 比較三個狀態在兩種指定投影測量下的結果：第一種是具有結果投影 P0​=∣0⟩⟨0∣ 的基底測量，第二種具有結果投影 P+​=∣+⟩⟨+∣。各投影均搭配其互補投影。機率可由矩陣相乘或重疊模平方算得。這兩種測量設定屬數學建構；若要實作其社會類比，須先定義觀察程序。

Table 6.1. Equal basis statistics need not determine the state. Entries are exact model probabilities, not empirical results.

表 6.1。 相同的基底統計不一定決定狀態。各項為模型的精確機率，並非實證結果。
State / 狀態Tr(ρP0​)Tr(ρP+​)

The first measurement alone cannot distinguish these states, while the second distinguishes their predicted distributions. Relative phase can matter for a specified measurement; global phase cannot. Even the two settings here do not identify every possible complex two-dimensional density operator, since they do not probe the imaginary part of its off-diagonal entry. Full state estimation needs sufficient known measurements and an explicit sampling model.

僅靠第一種測量無法區別這些狀態，第二種則可區分其預測分布。相對相位可能影響指定測量的結果，整體相位則不會。即使此處兩種設定合用，也不能識別所有可能的複二維密度算子，因為它們未探測非對角元素的虛部。完整狀態估計需要足夠且已知的測量，以及明確的取樣模型。

6.5 Composite systems and reduced states 6.5 複合系統與約化態

Definition 6.7 (Specified composition). For a chosen pair of subsystems use the tensor product below. The factorization and the association of each factor with observations must be stated. Its dimension multiplies rather than adds. Definition 6.8 (Product and separable states). Product states have the form ρA​⊗ρB​; separable states are convex mixtures of such products. A pure state is entangled exactly when no product-vector factorization exists. For mixed states, being non-product does not imply entanglement, as Chapter 5 demonstrates.

定義 6.7（指定的複合結構）。 對選定的兩個子系統採用以下張量積，並須明示因子分解及各因子與觀察的對應。其維度相乘，而非相加。定義 6.8（乘積態與可分態）。 乘積態形如 ρA​⊗ρB​；可分態是此類乘積的凸混合。純態恰在不存在乘積向量分解時具有纏結。對混態而言，非乘積不代表纏結，第 5 章已展示此點。

HAB​ρA​Tr[ρAB​(E⊗IB​)]​=HA​⊗HB​,dimHAB​=dA​dB​,=TrB​ρAB​,ρB​=TrA​ρAB​,=Tr(ρA​E).​(6.8)

For completeness, in product-basis coordinates the reduced matrix is (ρA​)ij​=∑b​(ρAB​)ib,jb​. It is Hermitian, has trace one and is positive because ⟨x∣ρA​∣x⟩=∑b​⟨x,b∣ρAB​∣x,b⟩≥0. Expanding the trace in the same basis proves the last line of Equation (6.8). This is the precise sense in which the reduced state supplies local probabilities; it need not recover joint correlations.

完整而言，在乘積基底座標中，約化矩陣為 (ρA​)ij​=∑b​(ρAB​)ib,jb​。它為 Hermitian、跡為一，且由 ⟨x∣ρA​∣x⟩=∑b​⟨x,b∣ρAB​∣x,b⟩≥0 可知其半正定。在相同基底展開跡，即證得式（6.8）的最後一行。這精確界定約化態如何提供局部機率；它不一定能回復聯合相關。

6.6 Observables and nonlinear summaries 6.6 可觀測量與非線性摘要量

Definition 6.9 (Scored measurement). Specify positive measurement effects Ey​ summing to Id​ and real scores oy​. The operator O and its expected score are then given by Equation (6.9). Alternatively, a Hermitian operator defines a projective measurement through its spectral projections and eigenvalue scores. In both cases, the operational meaning and units of the score must be supplied; naming an institutional quantity does not construct a measurement.

定義 6.9（帶分數的測量）。 指定總和為 Id​ 的半正定測量效應 Ey​ 與實數分數 oy​，便可由式（6.9）得到算子 O 及其期望分數。另一種方式是由 Hermitian 算子的譜投影與特徵值分數定義投影測量。無論何者，都須提供分數的操作意義與單位；替制度量命名並不等於建構測量。

O=y∑​oy​Ey​=O†,E[o]=y∑​oy​Tr(ρEy​)=Tr(ρO).(6.9)

This expectation is affine in the state. Nonlinear summaries, such as entropy, must be distinguished from the expectation of one fixed operator on a single copy of the state. For example, use base-two entropy with the zero-log convention. The two orthogonal pure states below have zero entropy, but their equal mixture has entropy one.

此期望值對狀態是仿射的。熵等非線性摘要量，須與對單份狀態使用同一固定算子所得的期望值區分。例如，採用以二為底、具零對數約定的熵，以下兩個正交純態的熵均為零，其等權混合的熵卻為一。

S(ρ)S(∣0⟩⟨0∣)S(21​∣0⟩⟨0∣+21​∣1⟩⟨1∣)​=−Tr(ρlog2​ρ),0log2​0:=0,=S(∣1⟩⟨1∣)=0,=S(I2​/2)=1.​(6.10)

Proof of the distinction. If one fixed operator had expectation equal to entropy for every two-dimensional state, linearity of the trace would give expectation zero on this mixture, contradicting Equation (6.10). The first-edition list of social observables therefore cannot automatically include entropy as a fixed linear observable. Estimating a nonlinear functional from many observations remains possible, but requires a separate estimator and uncertainty analysis.

此區分的證明。 若同一固定算子的期望對所有二維狀態都等於熵，跡的線性會使此混合態的期望為零，與式（6.10）矛盾。因此，第一版的社會可觀測量清單不能自動將熵列為固定線性可觀測量。從多次觀察估計非線性泛函仍有可能，但須另外提供估計器與不確定性分析。

6.7 Metrics on vectors, rays and density states 6.7 向量、射線與密度態的度量

The vector norm distance is a valid metric on vectors. However, a unit vector and its negative have vector distance two and represent the same pure state. It therefore does not descend unchanged to a metric on pure states. Definition 6.10 (Phase-invariant ray distance). Write [ψ] for the ray represented by a unit vector and define:

向量範數距離是向量上的合法度量。然而，單位向量與其負向量的向量距離為二，卻表示相同純態。因此，此距離不能原封不動地成為純態上的度量。定義 6.10（相位不變的射線距離）。 以 [ψ] 表示單位向量代表的射線，並定義：

dray​([ψ],[ϕ])​=θ∈[0,2π]min​​∣ψ⟩−eiθ∣ϕ⟩​=2−2∣⟨ψ∣ϕ⟩∣​.​(6.11)

Proposition 6.3 (Ray metric). Equation (6.11) defines a metric on the unit-vector rays. Proof. Expanding the squared norm gives 2−2Re(eiθ⟨ψ∣ϕ⟩); maximizing the real part over phase yields the stated formula. The minimum exists by continuity on the compact phase interval. Nonnegativity and symmetry follow immediately. By Proposition 6.1, zero distance holds exactly for the same ray. For the triangle inequality, choose unit representatives of the first and middle rays that attain their minimum; then choose a representative of the third ray attaining its minimum distance to that middle representative. The ordinary vector triangle inequality bounds the distance between the first and third representatives by the sum of the two ray distances. Minimizing over their relative phase can only decrease the left side. This proves the triangle inequality and the proposition.

命題 6.3（射線度量）。 式（6.11）定義單位向量射線上的度量。證明。 展開範數平方得 2−2Re(eiθ⟨ψ∣ϕ⟩)；對相位最大化實部即得所列公式。由於相位區間緊緻且函數連續，最小值存在。非負性與對稱性直接成立；依命題 6.1，距離為零恰好等價於同一射線。對三角不等式，先選取第一與中間射線的單位代表，使其達到最小距離；再選第三射線的代表，使其與該中間代表達到最小距離。通常的向量三角不等式，使第一與第三代表的距離不超過兩個射線距離之和；再對其相對相位最小化，只會使左側減小。三角不等式與命題均得證。

For mixed as well as pure states, one simple finite-dimensional matrix metric is the Hilbert–Schmidt distance. It is the Euclidean norm of the matrix entries of the difference, so its metric properties follow from those of a norm. For pure-state projectors it gives the second line below, obtained by expanding the square and using Tr(ρψ​ρϕ​)=∣⟨ψ∣ϕ⟩∣2. This metric is distinct from the ray distance above. Neither choice by itself measures the social cost of structural change; that interpretation needs validation and a declared representation.

對混態及純態，一種簡單的有限維矩陣度量是 Hilbert–Schmidt 距離。它是差矩陣各元素的歐氏範數，因此度量性質由範數性質得到。對純態投影，展開平方並使用 Tr(ρψ​ρϕ​)=∣⟨ψ∣ϕ⟩∣2，即得下式第二行。此度量不同於上述射線距離。任一選擇本身都不衡量結構改變的社會成本；該詮釋需要驗證並明定表示方式。

dHS​(ρ,σ)dHS​(ρψ​,ρϕ​)​=Tr[(ρ−σ)2]​,=2−2∣⟨ψ∣ϕ⟩∣2​.​(6.12)

6.8 Evolution and the limits of the finite model 6.8 演化與有限模型的界線

As an optional closed-model dynamics, let K(t) be a continuous Hermitian d×d matrix on the time interval considered. Use K in inverse-time units, consistent with Chapter 4, and choose a normalized initial vector at t0​. Finite-dimensional linear differential equations then give a unique differentiable solution. No universal social Planck constant is needed for this convention.

作為可選的封閉模型動力學，令 K(t) 為所考慮時間區間上的連續 Hermitian d×d 矩陣。與第 4 章一致，令 K 的單位為時間的倒數，並在 t0​ 選取歸一化初始向量。有限維線性微分方程因而給出唯一可微解。此約定不需要普遍的社會 Planck 常數。

idtd​∣ψ(t)⟩=K(t)∣ψ(t)⟩,K(t)=K(t)†,∥ψ(t0​)∥=1.(6.13)

Theorem 6.1 (Normalization preservation). Under these assumptions the norm remains one. Proof. Taking the adjoint of the differential equation and applying the product rule yields Equation (6.14). Hence the squared norm is constant and equals its initial value. The initial normalization is necessary to conclude that the constant is one.

定理 6.1（歸一化守恆）。 在上述假設下，範數維持為一。證明。 對微分方程取伴隨並使用乘積法則，得到式（6.14）。因此範數平方為常數，等於其初始值。要斷定該常數為一，必須具有初始歸一化條件。

dtd​⟨ψ∣ψ⟩=i⟨ψ∣K†∣ψ⟩−i⟨ψ∣K∣ψ⟩=0.(6.14)

Corollary 6.1 (Unitary propagation). Let U(t,t0​) solve the same matrix equation with initial value Id​. The same calculation gives dtd​(U†U)=0, so U†U=Id​ and, in this finite square-matrix setting, U is unitary. Thus ρ(t)=U(t,t0​)ρ(t0​)U(t,t0​)† preserves positivity and trace for every density state. For constant K, U(t,t0​)=e−iK(t−t0​). This conclusion is mathematical; whether it models an organization is a separate question.

推論 6.1（酉傳播）。 令 U(t,t0​) 滿足相同的矩陣方程且初始值為 Id​。相同計算給出 dtd​(U†U)=0，故 U†U=Id​，在此有限方陣情況下 U 為酉矩陣。因此，ρ(t)=U(t,t0​)ρ(t0​)U(t,t0​)† 對任意密度態都保留半正定性與跡。當 K 為常數時，U(t,t0​)=e−iK(t−t0​)。這是數學結論；是否能描述組織則是另一個問題。

For an unconditional open-model update, Chapter 4 specifies completely positive trace-preserving maps. A norm-continuous time-homogeneous semigroup of such maps admits a Lindblad generator [2]. Openness alone does not imply those semigroup assumptions. General linear operators likewise need not preserve unit norm or even a nonzero vector. A physical or statistical update must be specified separately from an arbitrary operator acting on the Hilbert space.

對不保留條件結果的開放模型更新，第 4 章指定完全正且保跡的映射。若此類映射形成範數連續、時間齊次的半群，才具有 Lindblad 生成元［2］。單靠開放性不能推出這些半群假設。一般線性算子也不一定保留單位範數，甚至可能將向量送到零。因此，物理或統計更新必須與任意作用於 Hilbert 空間的算子分別指定。

Finally, this finite-dimensional core cannot contain an exact bosonic relation [a,a†]=Id​. Cyclicity of the finite matrix trace proves the obstruction below. Any later Fock-space or field-operator extension must specify a different space and appropriate operator domains, or disclose a truncation and its modified algebra. Finite-matrix calculations cannot silently validate an infinite-dimensional operator claim.

最後，此有限維核心不能容納精確玻色關係 [a,a†]=Id​。有限矩陣跡的循環性給出以下障礙。後續 Fock 空間或場算子擴充必須指定不同空間與適當算子定義域，或揭露截斷及其修改後的代數。有限矩陣計算不能默默地替無限維算子主張提供驗證。

Tr[a,a†]=Tr(aa†)−Tr(a†a)=0,TrId​=d>0.(6.15)

Appendix 6.A · Verification materials 附錄 6.A · 驗證材料

The complete verification program, bilingual reproduction guide and recorded output accompany this chapter. They check the rational nonorthogonal counterexample, formation normalization, Table 6.1, ensemble nonuniqueness, global-phase invariance, a reduced-state identity, the entropy counterexample and a finite commutator. A deterministic numerical check verifies a two-dimensional unitary trajectory and ray-metric examples with an explicit tolerance. These checks supplement the general proofs; they are not empirical data or a proof over all states.

本章附有完整驗證程式、英中重現指南與實際輸出，檢查有理數非正交反例、陣型歸一化、表 6.1、系綜非唯一性、整體相位不變性、約化態等式、熵反例及有限對易子。另以明示容許誤差進行確定性數值檢查，驗證二維酉軌跡與射線度量例子。這些檢查補充一般性證明，並非實證資料，也不是對所有狀態的證明。
