Chapter 7 · Social Field Operators and Local Excitations 第 7 章 · 社會場算子與局域激發

Inherited from Edition 1 · 第一版沿用，待審訂

Throughout this chapter, the mathematical structures adopted from Quantum Field Theory are employed as formal analogies for relational systems. They should not be interpreted as claims that human society obeys microscopic quantum mechanics.

本章通篇將從量子場論採納的數學結構作為關係系統的形式類比使用。不應被詮釋為主張人類社會服從微觀量子力學。

7.1 Field Operators 7.1 場算子

Definition 7.1 (Social Field Operator). A Social Field Operator Φ^(x,t) is a linear operator acting on HS​, mapping one admissible relational configuration into another: Φ^(x,t):HS​→HS​. The variables x and t represent generalized relational coordinates and temporal evolution rather than physical spacetime.

定義 7.1（社會場算子）。 社會場算子 Φ^(x,t) 是作用於 HS​ 的線性算子，將一個可允許關係配置映射到另一個：Φ^(x,t):HS​→HS​。變數 x 與 t 表示廣義關係座標與時間演化，而非物理時空。

7.2–7.5 Local Excitations, Creation, Annihilation and Number Operators 7.2–7.5 局域激發、產生、湮滅與數算子

Definition 7.2. A Local Excitation is defined as ∣ψi​⟩=a^i†​∣0⟩, where ∣0⟩ is the relational vacuum. Definition 7.3 (Relational Vacuum): a^i​∣0⟩=0 for every admissible excitation index. Creation and annihilation operators satisfy a^i†​∣ni​⟩=ni​+1​∣ni​+1⟩ and a^i​∣ni​⟩=ni​​∣ni​−1⟩. The number operator is N^i​=a^i†​a^i​.

定義 7.2。 局域激發定義為 ∣ψi​⟩=a^i†​∣0⟩，其中 ∣0⟩ 為關係真空。定義 7.3（關係真空）：對每一可允許激發指標，a^i​∣0⟩=0。產生與湮滅算子滿足 a^i†​∣ni​⟩=ni​+1​∣ni​+1⟩ 與 a^i​∣ni​⟩=ni​​∣ni​−1⟩。數算子為 N^i​=a^i†​a^i​。

7.6 Canonical Commutation Relations 7.6 正則對易關係

Bosonic relational operators satisfy [a^i​,a^j†​]=δij​, [a^i​,a^j​]=0, [a^i†​,a^j†​]=0. These relations define the operator algebra of independent relational modes.

玻色型關係算子滿足 [a^i​,a^j†​]=δij​、[a^i​,a^j​]=0、[a^i†​,a^j†​]=0。這些關係定義獨立關係模的算子代數。

7.7–7.8 Field Expansion and Interaction Operator 7.7–7.8 場展開與相互作用算子

The social field operator admits the expansion Φ^(x,t)=∑i​(ui​(x,t)a^i​+ui∗​(x,t)a^i†​). Interactions among relational modes are generated by H^int​=∑ij​gij​a^i†​a^j​, where gij​ is the coupling matrix.

社會場算子可展開為 Φ^(x,t)=∑i​(ui​(x,t)a^i​+ui∗​(x,t)a^i†​)。關係模之間的相互作用由 H^int​=∑ij​gij​a^i†​a^j​ 產生，其中 gij​ 為耦合矩陣。

7.9–7.12 Measurement, Evolution, Symmetry and Lie Algebra 7.9–7.12 測量、演化、對稱與李代數

Observable quantities correspond to Hermitian operators O^=O^† with ⟨O⟩=Tr(ρO^). Time evolution is generated by U(t)=exp(−iHt/ℏ). A continuous symmetry transformation is generated by G such that U(θ)=e−iθG. The generators satisfy the Lie algebra [Gi​,Gj​]=ifijk​Gk​.

可觀測量對應厄米算子 O^=O^†，且 ⟨O⟩=Tr(ρO^)。時間演化由 U(t)=exp(−iHt/ℏ) 產生。連續對稱變換由 G 產生，滿足 U(θ)=e−iθG。生成元滿足李代數 [Gi​,Gj​]=ifijk​Gk​。

7.13–7.14 Structural Hamiltonian and Open-System Dynamics 7.13–7.14 結構哈密頓量與開放系統動力學

The total generator is H=H0​+Hint​+Henv​. The density operator evolves according to the Lindblad equation. Theorem 7.1 (Conservation of Total Probability): If Tr(ρ)=1 initially, then the Lindblad evolution preserves Tr(ρ(t))=1.

總生成元為 H=H0​+Hint​+Henv​。密度算子依 Lindblad 方程演化。定理 7.1（總機率守恆）：若初始 Tr(ρ)=1，則 Lindblad 演化保持 Tr(ρ(t))=1。

The operator formalism developed in this chapter is an abstract mathematical language for describing the creation, evolution, interaction, and disappearance of relational configurations. Creation and annihilation operators should therefore be interpreted as generators of structural change rather than the literal production or destruction of physical particles.

本章發展的算子形式是描述關係配置之產生、演化、相互作用與消失的抽象數學語言。因此產生與湮滅算子應被詮釋為結構變化的生成元，而非物理粒子的字面產生或毀滅。

Chapter 8 · The Social Metric Tensor and Field Geometry 第 8 章 · 社會度量張量與場幾何

Inherited from Edition 1 · 第一版沿用，待審訂

8.1 Topological Description of Social Fields 8.1 社會場的拓撲描述

Definition 8.1 (Social Topological Space). Let M be a differentiable manifold representing the configuration space of admissible relational structures. A social field is defined as a continuous mapping Φ:M→HS​, where HS​ is the Social Hilbert Space introduced in Chapter 6.

定義 8.1（社會拓撲空間）。 令 M 為表示可允許關係結構配置空間的可微流形。社會場定義為連續映射 Φ:M→HS​，其中 HS​ 為第 6 章引入的社會希爾伯特空間。

8.2–8.4 Structural Continuity, Topological Equivalence and Invariants 8.2–8.4 結構連續性、拓撲等價與不變量

A structural evolution Φt​ is continuous if limt→t0​​∥Φ(t)−Φ(t0​)∥=0. Two relational structures Φ1​,Φ2​ are topologically equivalent whenever there exists a homeomorphism f:Φ1​→Φ2​. Topological equivalence implies identical relational connectivity despite differences in local geometry.

結構演化 Φt​ 是連續的，若 limt→t0​​∥Φ(t)−Φ(t0​)∥=0。兩個關係結構 Φ1​,Φ2​ 在拓撲上等價，當且僅當存在同胚 f:Φ1​→Φ2​。拓撲等價意味著儘管局部幾何不同，關係連通性相同。

8.5–8.9 Structural Defects, Homotopy, Phase and Order Parameter 8.5–8.9 結構缺陷、同倫、相與序參數

A topological defect is a localized singular configuration D⊂M where Φ fails to remain globally continuous (e.g. constitutional crises, organizational fragmentation, institutional collapse). Two field configurations belong to the same homotopy class if Φ1​≃Φ2​. A structural phase is an equivalence class of relational configurations characterized by identical macroscopic order parameters. An order parameter η satisfies η=0 for disordered configurations and η=0 for ordered ones, with η=⟨O^⟩.

拓撲缺陷是局域奇異配置 D⊂M，在此 Φ 無法保持全域連續（例如憲政危機、組織碎片化、制度崩解）。兩個場配置屬於同一同倫類若 Φ1​≃Φ2​。結構相是由相同宏觀序參數刻畫的關係配置等價類。序參數 η 在無序配置滿足 η=0，在有序配置滿足 η=0，且 η=⟨O^⟩。

8.10–8.14 Symmetry Breaking, Collapse, Topological Protection and Stability 8.10–8.14 對稱破缺、塌縮、拓撲保護與穩定性

Above the critical point, G→H with H⊂G (spontaneous symmetry reduction). Structural collapse is represented by ρ→PρP. A configuration is topologically protected if no continuous deformation can change its invariant Q (δQ=0). Theorem 8.1 (Topological Stability): If the governing invariant Q remains unchanged under continuous perturbations, the relational structure cannot undergo qualitative reorganization without crossing a topological transition.

臨界點之上，G→H 且 H⊂G（自發對稱約化）。結構塌縮表示為 ρ→PρP。若無連續形變能改變其不變量 Q（δQ=0），則配置受拓撲保護。定理 8.1（拓撲穩定性）：若支配不變量 Q 在連續擾動下保持不變，則關係結構無法在不跨越拓撲轉變的情況下發生質性重組。

Chapter 9 · Renormalization and Multi-Scale Dynamics of Social Fields 第 9 章 · 社會場的重整化與多尺度動力學

Inherited from Edition 1 · 第一版沿用，待審訂

9.1–9.3 Scale Dependence, Coarse-Graining and Effective Field 9.1–9.3 尺度依賴、粗粒化與有效場

Definition 9.1 (Observation Scale). Let ℓ denote the characteristic observation scale. A relational field is represented as Φ(x;ℓ), where the observable structure depends explicitly on the scale of description. A coarse-graining transformation Cb​ with scaling factor b>1 maps microscopic configurations into effective macroscopic variables: Φ(x;ℓ)→Φ′(x;bℓ). The effective field at scale ℓ is Φeff​(ℓ), whose dynamics reproduce observable behavior above that scale.

定義 9.1（觀測尺度）。 令 ℓ 表示特徵觀測尺度。關係場表示為 Φ(x;ℓ)，可觀測結構明確依賴描述尺度。粗粒化變換 Cb​（尺度因子 b>1）將微觀配置映射為有效宏觀變數：Φ(x;ℓ)→Φ′(x;bℓ)。尺度 ℓ 上的有效場為 Φeff​(ℓ)，其動力學再現該尺度以上的可觀測行為。

9.4–9.5 Effective Hamiltonian and Running Couplings 9.4–9.5 有效哈密頓量與跑動耦合

The effective Hamiltonian is written as Heff​=H0​+∑i​gi​(ℓ)Oi​, where gi​(ℓ) are scale-dependent coupling constants. A coupling constant depends on scale: gi​=gi​(ℓ).

有效哈密頓量寫為 Heff​=H0​+∑i​gi​(ℓ)Oi​，其中 gi​(ℓ) 為尺度依賴耦合常數。耦合常數依賴尺度：gi​=gi​(ℓ)。

9.6–9.9 Beta Functions, Fixed Points, Universality and Operator Classification 9.6–9.9 β 函數、固定點、普適性與算子分類

The beta function is defined as βi​(g)=ℓdℓdgi​​. A fixed point satisfies βi​(g∗)=0, at which the effective description becomes scale-invariant. Distinct microscopic systems belong to the same universality class whenever they flow toward the same fixed point. Operators are classified as relevant (Δi​<d), marginal (Δi​=d), or irrelevant (Δi​>d).

β 函數定義為 βi​(g)=ℓdℓdgi​​。固定點滿足 βi​(g∗)=0，此時有效描述成為尺度不變。不同微觀系統只要流向同一固定點，即屬於同一普適類。算子分類為相關（Δi​<d）、邊緣（Δi​=d）或不相關（Δi​>d）。

9.10–9.14 Scale Transformation, Critical Phenomena, Multi-Level Institutions and Renormalization Flow 9.10–9.14 尺度變換、臨界現象、多層制度與重整化流

Under rescaling x→bx, the field transforms as Φ(x)→b−ΔΦ(bx). Near the critical scale the relational correlation length ξ→∞. Renormalization defines mappings between successive organizational levels. Theorem 9.1 (Scale Invariance at Fixed Points): If β(g∗)=0, the effective theory is invariant under further renormalization transformations. Stable social institutions correspond to attractive fixed points of the renormalization flow.

在重標度 x→bx 下，場變換為 Φ(x)→b−ΔΦ(bx)。接近臨界尺度時，關係關聯長度 ξ→∞。重整化定義連續組織層級之間的映射。定理 9.1（固定點的尺度不變性）：若 β(g∗)=0，有效理論在進一步重整化變換下不變。穩定社會制度對應重整化流的吸引固定點。

Chapter 10 · Gauge Symmetry and Conservation Laws in Social Fields 第 10 章 · 社會場中的規範對稱與守恆定律

Inherited from Edition 1 · 第一版沿用，待審訂

10.1–10.2 Local and Global Symmetry 10.1–10.2 局域與全域對稱

Definition 10.1 (Gauge Transformation). A local gauge transformation is defined by Ψ(x)→Ψ′(x)=U(x)Ψ(x), where U(x)∈G varies over the relational manifold. A global transformation satisfies U(x)=U (constant), while a local transformation satisfies ∇U(x)=0.

定義 10.1（規範變換）。 局域規範變換定義為 Ψ(x)→Ψ′(x)=U(x)Ψ(x)，其中 U(x)∈G 在關係流形上變化。全域變換滿足 U(x)=U（常數），局域變換滿足 ∇U(x)=0。

10.3–10.5 Covariant Derivative, Social Gauge Field and Gauge Curvature 10.3–10.5 協變導數、社會規範場與規範曲率

Ordinary differentiation is replaced by the covariant derivative Dμ​=∂μ​+igAμ​, where Aμ​ is the social gauge field representing institutional or normative structure mediating interactions. The field-strength tensor is Fμν​=∂μ​Aν​−∂ν​Aμ​+ig[Aμ​,Aν​]. Large curvature corresponds to rapid institutional or organizational change.

普通微分由協變導數 Dμ​=∂μ​+igAμ​ 取代，其中 Aμ​ 為社會規範場，表示中介相互作用的制度或規範結構。場強張量為 Fμν​=∂μ​Aν​−∂ν​Aμ​+ig[Aμ​,Aν​]。大曲率對應快速的制度或組織變化。

10.6–10.7 Gauge-Invariant Dynamics and Euler–Lagrange Equation 10.6–10.7 規範不變動力學與歐拉–拉格朗日方程

The Lagrangian density is L=(Dμ​Ψ)†(DμΨ)−V(Ψ)−41​Fμν​Fμν. Variation of the action S=∫Ld4x yields the Euler–Lagrange equation governing the evolution of relational fields.

拉格朗日密度為 L=(Dμ​Ψ)†(DμΨ)−V(Ψ)−41​Fμν​Fμν。對作用量 S=∫Ld4x 變分，得到支配關係場演化的歐拉–拉格朗日方程。

10.8–10.11 Conserved Current, Noether Charge, Gauge Constraints and Gauge Fixing 10.8–10.11 守恆流、Noether 荷、規範約束與規範固定

Gauge symmetry implies the existence of a conserved current Jμ satisfying ∂μ​Jμ=0. The conserved quantity (Noether charge) is Q=∫J0d3x. Possible conserved quantities include institutional legitimacy, organizational identity, constitutional continuity, and persistent symbolic capital. Allowed configurations satisfy the gauge constraint Ga​(Ψ)=0. Gauge fixing chooses a condition χ(A)=0; different gauge choices correspond to different mathematical representations of the same relational structure.

規範對稱意味著存在守恆流 Jμ，滿足 ∂μ​Jμ=0。守恆量（Noether 荷）為 Q=∫J0d3x。可能的守恆量包括制度正當性、組織認同、憲政延續性與持續的象徵資本。可允許配置滿足規範約束 Ga​(Ψ)=0。規範固定選擇條件 χ(A)=0；不同規範選擇對應同一關係結構的不同數學表示。

10.12–10.14 Symmetry Breaking, Emergent Structures and Gauge Stability 10.12–10.14 對稱破缺、湧現結構與規範穩定性

Spontaneous symmetry breaking produces new stable institutional configurations (G→H with H⊂G). Proposition 10.1: If two relational descriptions are connected by a gauge transformation Ψ′=UΨ, then every gauge-invariant observable satisfies O(Ψ′)=O(Ψ). Theorem 10.1 (Gauge Equivalence): Configurations connected by a smooth local gauge transformation describe the same physical relational structure. The physical content of the theory is encoded in gauge-invariant quantities rather than in any particular representation.

自發對稱破缺產生新的穩定制度配置（G→H 且 H⊂G）。命題 10.1：若兩個關係描述由規範變換 Ψ′=UΨ 連接，則每一規範不變量滿足 O(Ψ′)=O(Ψ)。定理 10.1（規範等價）：由光滑局域規範變換連接的配置描述相同的物理關係結構。理論的物理內容編碼於規範不變量，而非任何特定表示。

Volume I Summary. Chapters 1–10 establish the mathematical core of Social Quantum Field Theory: philosophical foundations, the eight axioms, the worked model of relational coordination, the Social Hilbert Space, field operators, topology and geometry, renormalization, and gauge symmetry with conservation laws. Together they provide the unified formal framework upon which subsequent volumes are constructed.

第一卷總結。 第 1–10 章建立了社會量子場論的數學核心：哲學基礎、八公理、關係協調工作模型、社會希爾伯特空間、場算子、拓撲與幾何、重整化，以及規範對稱與守恆定律。它們共同提供後續卷冊所建構的統一形式框架。

Chapter 11 · Information Geometry and Relational Entropy 第 11 章 · 資訊幾何與關係熵

Inherited from Edition 1 · 第一版沿用，待審訂

11.1–11.3 Relational Information, Entropy and Maximum Entropy 11.1–11.3 關係資訊、熵與最大熵

The informational content of a social field is determined by its relational organization rather than by isolated individual states. Relational entropy is defined by SR​(ρ)=−Tr(ρlnρ). For every admissible density operator SR​(ρ)≥0, with equality if and only if ρ is a pure relational state. For an N-dimensional Hilbert space, SR​≤lnN, with equality when ρ=I/N (maximal structural uncertainty).

社會場的資訊內容由其關係組織決定，而非孤立的個體狀態。關係熵定義為 SR​(ρ)=−Tr(ρlnρ)。對每一可允許密度算子 SR​(ρ)≥0，等號成立若且唯若 ρ 為純關係狀態。對 N 維希爾伯特空間，SR​≤lnN，當 ρ=I/N 時等號成立（最大結構不確定性）。

11.4–11.6 Relative Entropy, Mutual Information and Conditional Mutual Information 11.4–11.6 相對熵、互資訊與條件互資訊

Relative entropy is D(ρ∥σ)=Tr(ρ(lnρ−lnσ))≥0. Mutual information I(A:B)=S(A)+S(B)−S(A,B) measures total relational correlation. Conditional mutual information I(A:B∣C) isolates direct relational dependence after removing shared contextual effects.

相對熵為 D(ρ∥σ)=Tr(ρ(lnρ−lnσ))≥0。互資訊 I(A:B)=S(A)+S(B)−S(A,B) 測量總關係關聯。條件互資訊 I(A:B∣C) 在移除共享脈絡效應後，分離直接關係依賴。

11.7–11.9 Information Metric, Distance and Curvature 11.7–11.9 資訊度量、距離與曲率

The Fisher information metric gij​=E[∂i​lnρ∂j​lnρ] equips the space of relational models with a Riemannian geometry. Information distance is ds2=gij​dθidθj. Positive curvature indicates highly integrated relational organization; negative curvature indicates fragmented structure.

Fisher 資訊度量 gij​=E[∂i​lnρ∂j​lnρ] 為關係模型空間配備黎曼幾何。資訊距離為 ds2=gij​dθidθj。正曲率表示高度整合的關係組織；負曲率表示碎片化結構。

11.10–11.14 Information Flow, Potential, Stability and Entropy Production 11.10–11.14 資訊流、勢、穩定性與熵產生

An information potential VI​(ρ) determines preferred directions of structural evolution. Stable configurations correspond to local minima. For open systems, dtdSR​​=Π−Φ. Theorem 11.1 (Monotonicity of Relative Entropy): Under completely positive trace-preserving maps, relative entropy cannot increase. Institutional resilience increases as mutual information among components increases while relational entropy remains bounded.

資訊勢 VI​(ρ) 決定結構演化的偏好方向。穩定配置對應局部極小。對開放系統，dtdSR​​=Π−Φ。定理 11.1（相對熵的單調性）：在完全正且保跡映射下，相對熵不會增加。當組織成分之間的互資訊增加而關係熵保持有界時，制度韌性增加。

Chapter 12 · Emergence, Structural Collapse, and Open-System Dynamics 第 12 章 · 湧現、結構塌縮與開放系統動力學

Inherited from Edition 1 · 第一版沿用，待審訂

12.1 Emergent Relational Structures 12.1 湧現的關係結構

Definition 12.1 (Emergence). Let S={A1​,A2​,…,An​} denote a collection of local excitations. An emergent structure is a higher-order relational configuration that cannot be reduced to the independent properties of the Ai​.

定義 12.1（湧現）。 令 S={A1​,A2​,…,An​} 表示局域激發的集合。湧現結構是無法還原為 Ai​ 獨立性質的高階關係配置。

12.2–12.4 Collective Order, Structural Potential and Stability 12.2–12.4 集體秩序、結構勢與穩定性

The macroscopic order parameter is η=⟨O^⟩. The structural potential is V(η)=aη2+bη4 (b>0). Equilibrium configurations satisfy dV/dη=0; stable equilibria require d2V/dη2>0.

宏觀序參數為 η=⟨O^⟩。結構勢為 V(η)=aη2+bη4（b>0）。平衡配置滿足 dV/dη=0；穩定平衡要求 d2V/dη2>0。

12.5–12.7 Structural Collapse, Critical Surface and Open-System Evolution 12.5–12.7 結構塌縮、臨界曲面與開放系統演化

A structural collapse is a discontinuous transition ρ−​→ρ+​ represented by ρ+​=Pρ−​P. Criticality occurs when an external control parameter λ=λc​. The density operator evolves according to the Lindblad equation.

結構塌縮是不連續轉變 ρ−​→ρ+​，表示為 ρ+​=Pρ−​P。當外部控制參數 λ=λc​ 時發生臨界。密度算子依 Lindblad 方程演化。

12.8–12.14 Dissipation, Resilience, Memory, Attractors and Bifurcation 12.8–12.14 耗散、韌性、記憶、吸引子與分岔

The dissipation functional governs irreversible structural evolution. The resilience index is Rs​=1/τ. An attractor is a subset of the relational state space to which trajectories converge. A bifurcation occurs when det(J)=0. Theorem 12.1 (Stability of Stationary States): If every eigenvalue of the linearized Jacobian satisfies Re(λi​)<0, then the stationary state is asymptotically stable.

耗散泛函支配不可逆結構演化。韌性指數為 Rs​=1/τ。吸引子是關係狀態空間中軌跡收斂的子集。當 det(J)=0 時發生分岔。定理 12.1（平穩狀態的穩定性）：若線性化雅可比的每一特徵值滿足 Re(λi​)<0，則平穩狀態為漸近穩定。

Chapter 13 · Mathematical Foundations for Empirical Verification 第 13 章 · 經驗驗證的數學基礎

Inherited from Edition 1 · 第一版沿用，待審訂

13.1 Observable Relational Variables 13.1 可觀測的關係變數

Definition 13.1 (Observable). A social observable is a Hermitian operator O^=O^† whose expectation value is ⟨O⟩=Tr(ρO^).

定義 13.1（可觀測量）。 社會可觀測量是厄米算子 O^=O^†，其期望值為 ⟨O⟩=Tr(ρO^)。

13.2–13.5 Measurement Space, Observation Operator, Structural Estimation and Likelihood 13.2–13.5 測量空間、觀測算子、結構估計與似然

The empirical measurement space is X={X1​,…,Xn​} with Xi​=fi​(ρ). The observation mapping M:HS​→Rm yields y=M(ρ). Parameter estimation seeks θ^=argminθ​L(θ). Maximum-likelihood estimation satisfies θ^=argmaxθ​L(θ).

經驗測量空間為 X={X1​,…,Xn​}，且 Xi​=fi​(ρ)。觀測映射 M:HS​→Rm 產生 y=M(ρ)。參數估計尋求 θ^=argminθ​L(θ)。最大似然估計滿足 θ^=argmaxθ​L(θ)。

13.6–13.10 Bayesian Updating, Residuals, Goodness of Fit and Prediction 13.6–13.10 貝葉斯更新、殘差、擬合優度與預測

The posterior is P(θ∣D)=P(D∣θ)P(θ)/P(D). Goodness of fit is measured by R2. Future states satisfy ρ(t+Δt)=TΔt​ρ(t). Forecast error E(t)=∥ρobs​−ρpred​∥ should approach zero under model refinement.

後驗為 P(θ∣D)=P(D∣θ)P(θ)/P(D)。擬合優度由 R2 測量。未來狀態滿足 ρ(t+Δt)=TΔt​ρ(t)。預測誤差 E(t)=∥ρobs​−ρpred​∥ 在模型精煉下應趨近零。

13.11–13.14 Model Comparison, Identifiability, Validation and Consistency 13.11–13.14 模型比較、可識別性、驗證與一致性

Theorem 13.1 (Empirical Identifiability): If the observation map M is injective over the admissible parameter space, each observable relational configuration uniquely determines its theoretical parameter vector. A relational theory is empirically testable if there exists a measurable mapping allowing quantitative comparison of theoretical predictions and empirical observations.

定理 13.1（經驗可識別性）：若觀測映射 M 在可允許參數空間上為單射，則每一可觀測關係配置唯一決定其理論參數向量。若存在可測量映射使理論預測與經驗觀測能定量比較，則關係理論可經驗檢證。

Chapter 14 · Mathematical Criteria for Falsifiability and Scientific Validity 第 14 章 · 可否證性與科學有效性的數學判準

Inherited from Edition 1 · 第一版沿用，待審訂

14.1–14.3 Scientific Hypothesis, Predictive Function and Falsifiability 14.1–14.3 科學假說、預測函數與可否證性

Definition 14.1 (Relational Hypothesis). A scientific hypothesis is a mapping T:Θ→O from parameter space to observable space. The prediction operator is P:Θ→Y yielding y^​=P(θ). Definition 14.2 (Falsifiability): A theory is falsifiable if there exists at least one observation y∗ such that y∗=P(θ) for every admissible parameter θ.

定義 14.1（關係假說）。 科學假說是從參數空間到可觀測空間的映射 T:Θ→O。預測算子為 P:Θ→Y，產生 y^​=P(θ)。定義 14.2（可否證性）：若存在至少一個觀測 y∗，使得對每一可允許參數 θ 皆有 y∗=P(θ)，則理論可否證。

14.4–14.8 Experimental Domain, Error Functional, Robustness, Sensitivity and Information Criterion 14.4–14.8 實驗領域、誤差泛函、穩健性、敏感度與資訊準則

The empirical validity region is ΩV​⊆Ω. The error functional is E(θ)=∥yobs​−P(θ)∥2. A model is robust if small parameter perturbations produce bounded changes in predictions. Model complexity is evaluated through AIC =2k−2lnL and BIC.

經驗有效區域為 ΩV​⊆Ω。誤差泛函為 E(θ)=∥yobs​−P(θ)∥2。若小參數擾動產生有界預測變化，則模型穩健。模型複雜度透過 AIC =2k−2lnL 與 BIC 評估。

14.9–14.14 Cross Validation, Structural Stability, Refutation, Consistency and Scientific Status 14.9–14.14 交叉驗證、結構穩定性、反駁、一致性與科學地位

Definition 14.4 (Refutation Criterion): SQFT is empirically refuted whenever repeated independent observations satisfy E(θ)>ε for every admissible parameter set. Mathematical Remark. The objective of Social Quantum Field Theory is not to assert that social systems are quantum mechanical in a microscopic physical sense, but to formulate a mathematically rigorous field theory of relational structures. By integrating operator theory, open-system dynamics, topology, geometry, renormalization, and information theory within a single axiomatic framework, SQFT provides a coherent foundation for analyzing the evolution of complex social systems.

數學備註。 社會量子場論的目標並非主張社會系統在微觀物理意義上是量子力學的，而是要建構關係結構的嚴格數學場論。透過在單一公理框架內整合算子理論、開放系統動力學、拓撲、幾何、重整化與資訊理論，SQFT 為分析複雜社會系統的演化提供連貫基礎。

Volume II Summary. Chapters 11–18 develop information geometry and relational entropy, the dynamics of emergence and structural collapse, mathematical foundations for empirical verification and falsifiability, the scope and limitations of the theory, concrete applications across organizational, economic, political and digital domains, computational implementation, and the unified mathematical architecture of social fields. Together with Volume I they complete the formal core of Social Quantum Field Theory. Extensive appendices (Notation, Glossary, and Concluding Remarks) further support the framework.

第二卷總結。 第 11–18 章發展資訊幾何與關係熵、湧現與結構塌縮動力學、經驗驗證與可否證性的數學基礎、理論範圍與限制、組織／經濟／政治／數位領域的具體應用、計算實現，以及社會場的統一數學架構。與第一卷共同完成社會量子場論的形式核心。詳細附錄（符號表、詞彙表與結語）進一步支撐此框架。

Individuals are modeled as localized excitations of an evolving relational field rather than isolated units. A relational vacuum ∣0⟩ is the reference configuration with no localized excitations present; it contains structural potential rather than empirical emptiness. A localized excitation is ∣i⟩=ai†​∣0⟩, interpreted as the mathematical representation of a locally activated relational state (individual, institution, organization, platform, etc.).

21.1–21.3 Introduction, Symmetric Relational States and Degenerate Ground States 21.1–21.3 引言、對稱關係狀態與簡併基態

Global order can emerge without any centralized controller (political consensus, institutional collapse, paradigm formation, market standards, cultural norms, technological lock-in). A relational system possesses structural symmetry if its governing equations remain invariant under a continuous symmetry group G. Degenerate ground states of an effective potential V(ϕ)=−μ2∣ϕ∣2+λ∣ϕ∣4 produce an entire family of equivalent minima.

全域秩序可在無中央控制者的情況下湧現（政治共識、制度崩解、範式形成、市場標準、文化規範、技術鎖定）。若支配方程在連續對稱群 G 下保持不變，則關係系統具有結構對稱。有效勢 V(ϕ)=−μ2∣ϕ∣2+λ∣ϕ∣4 的簡併基態產生一整族等價極小。

21.4–21.6 Institutional Ordering, Order Parameter and Collective Modes 21.4–21.6 制度秩序、序參數與集體模式

Although the governing equations remain symmetric, the observed configuration no longer exhibits the full symmetry — this is institutional ordering (common language, monetary standards, scientific conventions, technological platforms, legal institutions). An order parameter ϕ satisfies ϕ=0 in the disordered phase and ϕ=0 after ordering. Near equilibrium, small fluctuations ϕ=ϕ0​+δϕ correspond to collective modes (public opinion waves, organizational learning, coordinated innovation, cultural diffusion). Spontaneously broken continuous symmetries generate Goldstone-type modes that require little external effort to propagate.

雖然支配方程保持對稱，觀測配置不再展現完整對稱——此即制度秩序（共同語言、貨幣標準、科學慣例、技術平台、法律制度）。序參數 ϕ 在無序相滿足 ϕ=0，秩序化後 ϕ=0。接近平衡時，小漲落 ϕ=ϕ0​+δϕ 對應集體模式（輿論波、組織學習、協調創新、文化擴散）。自發破缺的連續對稱產生 Goldstone 型模式，僅需極少外部努力即可傳播。

External influences (H=H0​+Hint​+Hext​) bias equilibrium selection. 22.1–22.2 Introduction and Scale Dependence 22.1–22.2 引言與尺度依賴

Historical transformations (financial crises, political revolutions, technological revolutions, paradigm shifts) unfold through interactions across multiple organizational levels. The hierarchy Individual ⇒ Organization ⇒ Institution ⇒ Society implies that the mathematical description should depend explicitly upon the observational scale μ. An observation scale is the characteristic level at which relational interactions are represented.

歷史轉變（金融危機、政治革命、技術革命、範式轉移）透過跨多組織層級的相互作用展開。個體 ⇒ 組織 ⇒ 制度 ⇒ 社會的層級意味著數學描述應明確依賴觀測尺度 μ。觀測尺度是關係相互作用被表示的特徵層級。

22.3–22.6 Effective Theory, Coarse-Graining, Running Couplings and Fixed Points 22.3–22.6 有效理論、粗粒化、跑動耦合與固定點

The effective Hamiltonian at scale μ is H(μ)=Hrelevant​+Hirrelevant​. Coarse-graining replaces detailed relational configurations with effective macroscopic descriptions. Scale-dependent couplings obey μdg/dμ=β(g). A structural fixed point satisfies β(g∗)=0 and represents scale-invariant institutional organization (mature constitutional systems, stabilized scientific paradigms, global technological standards).

尺度 μ 上的有效哈密頓量為 H(μ)=Hrelevant​+Hirrelevant​。粗粒化以有效宏觀描述取代詳細關係配置。尺度依賴耦合服從 μdg/dμ=β(g)。結構固定點滿足 β(g∗)=0，表示尺度不變的制度組織（成熟憲政系統、穩定科學範式、全球技術標準）。

22.7–22.11 Universality, Critical Exponents, Institutional Criticality and Renormalization Flow 22.7–22.11 普適性、臨界指數、制度臨界性與重整化流

Different microscopic systems may converge toward common structural laws (universality). Near a structural transition, observables obey power laws such as ξ∝∣g−gc​∣−ν. As ξ→∞, local disturbances propagate across large regions of the relational field. Theorem 22.1 (Scale Invariance at Fixed Points): If β(g∗)=0, the corresponding effective relational theory is invariant under infinitesimal changes in observational scale.

不同微觀系統可能收斂至共同結構定律（普適性）。接近結構轉變時，可觀測量服從冪律，例如 ξ∝∣g−gc​∣−ν。當 ξ→∞，局域擾動可傳播至關係場的大片區域。定理 22.1（固定點的尺度不變性）：若 β(g∗)=0，對應的有效關係理論在觀測尺度的無窮小變化下不變。

Chapter 23 · Topological Phases and Topological Protection in Relational Systems 第 23 章 · 關係系統中的拓撲相與拓撲保護

Inherited from Edition 1 · 第一版沿用，待審訂

23.1 Introduction 23.1 引言

Certain social structures display remarkable robustness that cannot be explained by local interactions alone: constitutional traditions surviving political transitions, scientific methodologies persisting across generations, legal systems withstanding changes of government, monetary standards maintained through crises, engineering protocols remaining stable despite technological evolution. Such persistence depends on the global connectivity of the relational field — topological phases.

某些社會結構展現無法僅由局域相互作用解釋的顯著韌性：在政治轉變中存續的憲政傳統、跨世代持續的科學方法論、抵禦政府更迭的法律系統、在危機中維持的貨幣標準、儘管技術演化仍穩定的工程協議。此種持續性取決於關係場的全域連通性——拓撲相。

23.2–23.5 Relational Topology, Invariants, Betti Numbers and Persistent Homology 23.2–23.5 關係拓撲、不變量、Betti 數與持續同調

A relational network G=(V,E) has topology determined by global connectivity rather than precise interaction strengths. Topological invariants T(G) remain unchanged under continuous deformations. Betti numbers b0​, b1​, b2​ characterize connected components, independent cycles, and enclosed voids. Persistent homology tracks features that survive across wide intervals of a filtration and correspond to enduring alliances, long-term institutional arrangements, and resilient ecosystems.

關係網路 G=(V,E) 的拓撲由全域連通性而非精確相互作用強度決定。拓撲不變量 T(G) 在連續形變下保持不變。Betti 數 b0​、b1​、b2​ 表徵連通分量、獨立環與封閉空洞。持續同調追蹤在過濾寬廣區間內存續的特徵，對應持久聯盟、長期制度安排與韌性生態系。

23.6–23.10 Topological Protection, Phase Transition, Homotopy Classes, Stability and Robustness Theorem 23.6–23.10 拓撲保護、相變、同倫類、穩定性與韌性定理

Local disturbance ⇒ global institutional collapse; qualitative structural change requires a genuine topological transition. Distinct homotopy classes π1​(G) represent qualitatively different organizational architectures. Theorem 23.1 (Topological Robustness): If continuous perturbations preserve the topological invariant T, the system remains within the same topological phase. Institutional resilience therefore depends on preservation of global topological organization, not solely on the strength of individual relationships.

局域擾動 ⇒ 全域制度崩解；質性結構改變需要真正的拓撲轉變。不同同倫類 π1​(G) 代表質性不同的組織架構。定理 23.1（拓撲韌性）：若連續擾動保持拓撲不變量 T，系統仍處於同一拓撲相。制度韌性因此取決於全域拓撲組織的保存，而非僅取決於個別關係的強度。

Chapter 24 · Information Geometry and the Curvature of Relational Fields 第 24 章 · 資訊幾何與關係場的曲率

Inherited from Edition 1 · 第一版沿用，待審訂

24.1 Introduction 24.1 引言

Topology explains whether a relational structure belongs to the same global phase, but does not quantify how neighboring configurations differ or how rapidly they evolve. Information geometry supplies the missing geometric structure: curvature, distances, and geodesics on the space of relational states.

拓撲解釋關係結構是否屬於同一全域相，但不量化鄰近配置如何差異或演化多快。資訊幾何提供缺失的幾何結構：關係狀態空間上的曲率、距離與測地線。

24.2–24.5 Relational Statistical Manifold, Fisher Metric, Geodesics and Curvature 24.2–24.5 關係統計流形、Fisher 度量、測地線與曲率

The collection of admissible parameter values forms the relational statistical manifold M. The Fisher Information Matrix gij​=E[(∂i​lnP)(∂j​lnP)] defines the infinitesimal distance ds2=gij​dθidθj. Geodesics satisfy the usual second-order equation with Christoffel symbols and represent optimal structural evolution. Curvature is characterized by the Riemann, Ricci, and scalar curvature tensors; large positive curvature indicates constrained evolution and institutional rigidity, while negative curvature corresponds to rapidly diverging trajectories.

可容許參數值的集合構成關係統計流形 M。Fisher 資訊矩陣 gij​=E[(∂i​lnP)(∂j​lnP)] 定義無窮小距離 ds2=gij​dθidθj。測地線滿足含 Christoffel 符號的標準二階方程，代表最優結構演化。曲率由 Riemann、Ricci 與純量曲率張量表徵；大正曲率表示受約束演化與制度僵化，負曲率對應快速發散的軌跡。

24.6–24.10 Information Distance, Entropic Dynamics, Instability, Resilience and Geodesic Stability Theorem 24.6–24.10 資訊距離、熵動力學、不穩定性、韌性與測地穩定性定理

Information distance measures statistical separability. Entropic flow follows dθi/dt=−gij∂j​S. Rapid increases in curvature often precede structural transitions. Theorem 24.1 (Geodesic Stability): If sectional curvature remains uniformly bounded, sufficiently nearby relational trajectories remain continuously dependent upon their initial conditions over finite evolution intervals. Systems with moderate curvature, multiple geodesic pathways, and stable topological invariants exhibit greater institutional resilience.

資訊距離測量統計可分性。熵流遵循 dθi/dt=−gij∂j​S。曲率的快速增加常先於結構轉變。定理 24.1（測地穩定性）：若截面曲率保持均勻有界，足夠鄰近的關係軌跡在有限演化區間內對初始條件保持連續依賴。具有中等曲率、多重測地路徑與穩定拓撲不變量的系統展現更高制度韌性。

Chapter 25 · Quantum Information Theory and Relational Information Dynamics 第 25 章 · 量子資訊理論與關係資訊動力學

25.1–25.4 Introduction, Density Operator, Entropy and Reduced States 25.1–25.4 引言、密度算子、熵與約化狀態

Information is regarded as a property of the relational field itself. The complete relational state is the density operator ρ with ρ≥0, Tr(ρ)=1. Relational entropy is the von Neumann entropy S(ρ)=−Tr(ρlnρ). Reduced states of subsystems are obtained by partial trace: ρA​=TrB​(ρ).

資訊被視為關係場本身的性質。完整關係狀態為密度算子 ρ，滿足 ρ≥0、Tr(ρ)=1。關係熵為 von Neumann 熵 S(ρ)=−Tr(ρlnρ)。子系統的約化狀態由偏跡獲得：ρA​=TrB​(ρ)。

25.5–25.10 Mutual Information, Relative Entropy, Coherence, Information Flow and Conservation 25.5–25.10 互資訊、相對熵、相干、資訊流與守恆

Mutual information I(A:B)=S(A)+S(B)−S(AB)≥0 quantifies shared structure. Relative entropy D(ρ∥σ) measures distinguishability of configurations. Relational coherence C=∑i=j​∣ρij​∣ indicates synchronized expectations. Information flow is tracked by dS/dt; closed systems satisfy dStotal​/dt=0. Theorem 25.1 (Non-Negativity of Relational Mutual Information): For any bipartite relational state, I(A:B)≥0.

互資訊 I(A:B)=S(A)+S(B)−S(AB)≥0 量化共享結構。相對熵 D(ρ∥σ) 測量配置的可區分性。關係相干 C=∑i=j​∣ρij​∣ 表示同步期望。資訊流由 dS/dt 追蹤；封閉系統滿足 dStotal​/dt=0。定理 25.1（關係互資訊的非負性）：對任何二分關係狀態，I(A:B)≥0。

Chapter 26 · Relational Entanglement Networks and Tensor Network Representations 第 26 章 · 關係糾纏網路與張量網路表示

26.1–26.5 Factorizable States, Multipartite Systems, Tensor Decomposition and Matrix Product States 26.1–26.5 可因子化狀態、多方系統、張量分解與矩陣乘積態

A relationally entangled state cannot be decomposed as a simple tensor product. The total Hilbert space is H=⨂i​Hi​, whose dimension grows exponentially. Tensor networks factor high-order tensors into low-rank tensors connected by contracted indices. Matrix Product States (MPS) efficiently represent approximately one-dimensional structures (hierarchical organizations, supply chains, command structures).

關係糾纏狀態無法分解為簡單張量積。總 Hilbert 空間為 H=⨂i​Hi​，維度指數增長。張量網路將高階張量分解為由收縮指標連接的低秩張量。矩陣乘積態（MPS）有效表示近似一維結構（層級組織、供應鏈、指揮結構）。

26.6–26.12 Tree Tensor Networks, PEPS, MERA, Entanglement Entropy, Graph Representation and Complexity 26.6–26.12 樹張量網路、PEPS、MERA、糾纏熵、圖表示與複雜度

Tree Tensor Networks (TTN) and Projected Entangled Pair States (PEPS) handle branching and higher-dimensional connectivity. MERA combines tensor decomposition with renormalization across scales. Entanglement entropy SA​=−Tr(ρA​lnρA​) quantifies statistical dependence on the surrounding field. Theorem 26.1: Systems obeying area-law scaling of entanglement entropy admit tensor-network approximations whose computational complexity grows only polynomially with system size.

樹張量網路（TTN）與投影糾纏對態（PEPS）處理分支與高維連通性。MERA 結合張量分解與跨尺度重整化。糾纏熵 SA​=−Tr(ρA​lnρA​) 量化對周圍場的統計依賴。定理 26.1：服從糾纏熵面積律縮放的系統容許計算複雜度僅隨系統大小多項式增長的張量網路近似。

Chapter 27 · Bayesian Inference and Statistical Learning in Social Quantum Field Theory 第 27 章 · 社會量子場論中的貝葉斯推斷與統計學習

27.1–27.3 Introduction, Unknown Parameters and Prior Knowledge 27.1–27.3 引言、未知參數與先驗知識

Bayesian inference treats model parameters as probability distributions continually updated by new evidence. The relational Hamiltonian depends on an unknown parameter vector θ. A prior distribution P(θ) encodes uncertainty before observations. Typical parameters include interaction strengths, coupling coefficients, diffusion rates, and external driving fields.

貝葉斯推斷將模型參數視為隨新證據持續更新的機率分布。關係哈密頓量依賴未知參數向量 θ。先驗分布 P(θ) 編碼觀測前的不確定性。典型參數包括相互作用強度、耦合係數、擴散率與外部驅動場。

27.4–27.12 Likelihood, Bayes’ Theorem, MAP, Adaptive Hamiltonians, Sequential Learning, Uncertainty and Prediction 27.4–27.12 似然、Bayes 定理、MAP、自適應哈密頓量、序列學習、不確定性與預測

Bayesian updating is governed by P(θ∣D)=P(D∣θ)P(θ)/P(D). MAP estimation incorporates prior knowledge. An adaptive Hamiltonian has parameters continually updated by Bayesian inference. Sequential learning enables online and real-time forecasting. Theorem 27.1 (Posterior Consistency): Under correct model specification and appropriate conditions, the posterior concentrates around the true parameter values as observational data accumulate.

貝葉斯更新由 P(θ∣D)=P(D∣θ)P(θ)/P(D) 支配。MAP 估計納入先驗知識。自適應哈密頓量的參數由貝葉斯推斷持續更新。序列學習支持線上與即時預測。定理 27.1（後驗一致性）：在模型正確指定與適當條件下，隨著觀測資料累積，後驗集中於真實參數值附近。

28.1–28.6 Theory-Constrained Learning, Physics-Informed Loss, Neural Fields, Graph Neural Networks and Hamiltonian Neural Networks 28.1–28.6 理論約束學習、物理資訊損失、神經場、圖神經網路與哈密頓神經網路

Operator learning approximates entire solution maps. Reinforcement learning designs policies compatible with relational field equations. 算子學習近似完整解映射。強化學習設計與關係場方程相容的策略。透過可解釋哈密頓量與明確不確定性估計優先考慮可解釋性。定理 28.1（理論約束泛化）：滿足 SQFT 結構約束的模型，其結構不一致性低於在相同觀測上訓練的無約束資料驅動預測器。
